Peter,

Republicans are the only thing stopping President Biden and Chuck Schumer from bankrupting our country.

This isn’t just political hyperbole. It’s as real as it gets!

It’s our Republican majority that allows us to hold them accountable. Without it, we would effectively be relegated to “sitting on the sidelines” and watching as:
* The Biden Administration does nothing to address the growing border crisis,

* **Crime continues to rise, and dangerous drugs pour into our country,**

* The Washington swamp holds critical funds hostage in order to send more untracked American tax dollars to Ukraine, and

* Liberals try to protect their political power by brazenly opposing election integrity measures ... _**even going as far as trying to keep President Trump off the ballot!**_****

But thankfully, our majority acts as a backstop against Democrats running roughshod over our values, our wallets, our country, and our constitution.
**_
But Peter,...all that goes away if we lose our majority in November’s election...and I would be lying to you if I told you that wasn’t a real possibility._**

As we head into the most important election in recent memory, our majority has recently shrunk from four to TWO.

**How did this happen?** Over the past couple of months there have been several Republican members of Congress who resigned or retired. Having such a slim majority puts us in a very precarious position going into an election year –and to be honest, we’re in real trouble right now, which is why I’m reaching out today.

Yesterday, hundreds of thousands of Granite Staters cast their ballots in the country's first primary. Donald Trump won. As I've written before, [what happens in New Hampshire won't stay in New Hampshire](https://substack.com/redirect/ea6d6833-da39-4acb-9f00-6ff2f8180b5d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). So what happened?
First of all, voters recognized the importance of the election; [turnout was higher than prior presidential primaries and included significant independent or "undeclared" voters](https://substack.com/redirect/69a2ad5a-6eae-4895-b7e4-0f76905e3688?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Several factors contributed to the high participation, including cooperative weather and a significant effort from New Hampshire's popular governor Chris Sununu. The Democrat primary had much lower turnout, and Congressman Dean Philips posted a reasonable showing given his recent candidacy. The main story, unsurprisingly, was the Republican primary.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/59c95d52-3c08-405c-9010-060185323f2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [https://decisiondeskhq.com/trump-beats-haley-in-new-hampshire-now-clear-favorite-to-secure-gop-nomination/](https://substack.com/redirect/2ac6633a-ae09-4b98-b481-3c14bcaa6b99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
There were some cross-currents in terms of pre-election expectations. A few weeks ago, [some polls were suggesting the gap between former President Trump and Ambassador Haley had converged to single digits](https://substack.com/redirect/40509196-df7a-42cc-8997-4ff24905f772?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). More recent polls suggested that former President Trump, in a head to head competition with Ambassador Haley, had a twenty-plus point lead. As of this writing, it appears President Trump won by more than eleven points.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..9_KJoMNMNWPoF0qmObMCZi98nsdmENEreR3rY42LnvU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=141006134)
Exit polls also revealed a great deal about New Hampshire voters concerns, and these insights will almost certainly go on to influence campaign strategies from now until November. [At the top of voter minds were the economy and immigration](https://substack.com/redirect/ba18764c-e41a-4865-81c2-6c4c4acb077f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Almost 70% of primary voters noted the economy was "not good" and 34% of those casting ballots felt it was the most important issue for them. Immigration closely followed the economy with 31% of primary voters saying it was their most important issue. Going forward, expect both campaigns to increase their focus and rhetoric on these two issues.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b9f9df27-508b-4712-b9ff-adec0989e525?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/new-hampshire-primary-sees-strong-turnout-unaffiliated-voters/story?id=106613187](https://substack.com/redirect/c631dcaf-351c-46df-a8bf-d66f188fd7a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[In terms of foreign policy, exit polls also revealed a large difference between Trump and Haley supporters when it came to the topic of foreign policy](https://substack.com/redirect/ba18764c-e41a-4865-81c2-6c4c4acb077f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). While only thirty percent of those who voted for Ambassador Haley wanted to see America less active in world affairs, about half of Trump's supporters wanted the country less engaged globally. As many observers are aware, there is a growing fissure within the Republican Party about America's role in the world, and that difference was on full display in New Hampshire.

As expected, there was also a notable difference in voter behavior based on education levels. Of those without college degrees, [more than two-thirds chose former President Trump while around 60% of college graduates who voted cast their ballot for Ambassador Haley](https://substack.com/redirect/ba18764c-e41a-4865-81c2-6c4c4acb077f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This trend mirrors national trends.

[Belief in the legitimacy of the 2020 election also divided those who voted along candidate lines](https://substack.com/redirect/ba18764c-e41a-4865-81c2-6c4c4acb077f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And let's also remember that the first three major contests (Iowa, New Hampshire, and South Carolina) are historically used to narrow the field of candidates, not to anoint a "chosen one." Through hard work, impressive debating, and effective campaigning, Ambassador Haley emerged from a crowded pack of hopefuls sooner than expected.

Some have also pointed to Haley's dependence upon undeclared voters as a source of weakness, suggesting that New Hampshire was her "best shot" as she lacks support within the Republican Party. This is also wrong, for two reasons. First, many Granite Staters avoid party association because different issues motivate them at different times. Some may be very conservative on social matters, while others may care deeply about national security. Lots of undeclared voters consistently vote Republican. Second, many of the upcoming primaries are open or semi-open, meaning independents will play a meaningful role. Michigan, Virginia, Texas, Maine, Massachusetts, Minnesota, North Carolina, and Vermont all fit into this category but follow South Carolina.

---|---|---
Ambassador Haley has developed undeniable momentum, having distinguished herself from a crowded field as the sole remaining viable alternative to former President Trump. Simply put, she's risen from 2% in the polls upon entering the race to earning more than 43% of the vote in New Hampshire. Let's also not forget that this was a three person race less than 36 hours before the New Hampshire primary began. Primary voters and even donors are still digesting the reality that we are in the midst of a two-person race.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/56abf9b9-6dba-4c60-863a-ff28938b5355?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Polls also show Haley beating Biden by a larger margin than Trump, a dynamic that could help Republicans down ballot in November. The popularity of songs such as [Oliver Anthony's Rich Men North of Richmond](https://substack.com/redirect/56abf9b9-6dba-4c60-863a-ff28938b5355?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) demonstrate a genuine desire for someone to "drain the swamp," for a non-establishment candidate. And yet President Trump, once a powerful disruptor, is now regularly parading establishment endorsers as validation of his momentum and popularity. Ambassador Haley is a next generation conservative disruptor. She's also the only one who can help make America normal again.

Finally, we need to acknowledge that there have been less than 500,000 votes cast in two states during the Republican primary so far. The millions of other voters in the other 48 states also deserve the ability to express their convictions. Bottom line: it is too early to think this race is over.

Friend,

They asked Kari to name her price to stay out of the race to Save America.

No shot in hell!

**Unlike DC politicians, she CANNOT be bought. She cares too much about this country to sit back, take their money, and fade into obscurity.**

There were very powerful people that wanted to keep Kari out of this race. The same people who are doing everything they can to keep President Trump out. These people hate what we stand for because they hate our country. They are willing to BRIBE her millions of dollars. They will try to stop her from WINNING because they know she can’t be bought. We need your help to send a message.

**Kari said it best. They’ll have to kill her if they want her to stop.**

This is a movement run, funded, and supported by WE THE PEOPLE. Kari may not have been the establishment’s first choice — but the people of Arizona and AMERICA are with HER.

Friend,

When I stepped off stage in New Hampshire, here is the message I shared...

You've all heard the chatter among the political class. They're falling all over themselves saying this race is over.

Well, I have news for all of them. New Hampshire is first in the nation. **_It 's not last in the nation._**

**This race is far from over.** There are dozens of states left to go. And the next one is my sweet state of South Carolina!

At one point in this campaign, there were 14 of us running, and we were at two percent in the polls. Well, I'm a fighter. Now, we're the last one standing next to Donald Trump, and today we got close to half of the vote. We still have a ways to go, but we keep moving up.

For a lot of people, politics is way too personal. It's not personal for me.

I decided to run because I'm worried about the future of our country, and because it's time to put the negativity and chaos behind us.

We have an economy that is crushing middle-class Americans. We have a border that is totally open and dangerous, creating a disaster in our country. We have schools that are failing too many of our children. And we have a world on fire, with war in Europe and the Middle East, and a huge and growing threat from China.

And then you look at Washington. We have a Congress that fights about everything and accomplishes nothing. And we have Joe Biden in the White House, making one bad decision after another, when he's making any decisions at all.

Our country's in a real mess. _And the question is, who 's going to fix it?_

With Donald Trump, Republicans have lost almost every competitive election. We lost the Senate. We lost the House. We lost the White House. We lost in 2018, in 2020 and in 2022.

The worst kept secret in politics is how badly the Democrats want to run against Trump. They know Trump is the only Republican in the country who Biden can defeat.

You can't fix the mess if you don't win the election. A Trump nomination is a Biden win and a Kamala Harris presidency.

**I defeat Biden handily.**

With Donald Trump, you have one bout of chaos after another. This court case, that controversy, this tweet, that senior moment. You can't fix Joe Biden's chaos with Republican chaos.

The other day, Donald Trump accused me of not providing security at the Capitol on January 6th.

I've long called for mental competency tests for politicians over the age of 75. Trump claims he'd do better than me on one of those tests. Maybe he would, and maybe he wouldn't.

But if he thinks that, then he should have no problem standing on a debate stage with me!

Most Americans do not want a rematch between Biden and Trump. The first party to retire its 80-year-old candidate is going to win this election. I say it should be the Republicans!

**So our fight is not over, because we have a country to save.** | [JOIN OUR MOVEMENT](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=0bf7192c5a01435eb08506bd86cdba4a&_e=ylrSDZzDovcNuLL-jJn85Mb3gV4Sf__DsgSl_Tgum-hI9mpDWSXE8vAx_EJciUuKGeNIUeZzN1T6BsgSMtctx5lWUsUbUNNtX1af9s-hRTwFV8e8njLE7SzeGUiWd5PLZ2SnANY4NVi4Skvpo223y4xsLjrpxNWLGNL4HxKA13B9CQOayfJR3LSusr44jox5SJMWNrJVTUqCC0yOf4wD6aeOZ7dBRU024wlY6Pcp83OD8l49Lcu_eSm7pC9L0QEc6M8oDrpr8EzLHUBGA6bwJChquC7VF-5XyJqaxLBHzm_vvfg09Gyi-0ymEFmfUE4NzXp0KFoybZQxDfFbsNbmGZ_cM0UrdlLc6LRn26NEEwM%3D)
---

In the next two months, millions of voters in over 20 states will have their say. We should honor them and allow them to vote. And guess what, in the next two months, Joe Biden isn't going to get any younger or any better. We'll have all the time we need to beat Biden.

When we get to South Carolina, Donald Trump is going to have a harder time falsely attacking me. The great people of South Carolina know I cut their taxes. They know I signed the toughest immigration bill in the country. They know we passed voter ID, and tort reform, and ethics reform, and they know we moved 35,000 people from welfare to work.

Every time I've run for office in South Carolina, I've beaten the political establishment. They're lined up against me again. That's no surprise. But South Carolina voters don't want a coronation. They want an election. And we're going to give them one.

Because we're just getting started.

**[Pitch in a donation to fuel my campaign and let's do this!](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=0bf7192c5a01435eb08506bd86cdba4a&_e=ylrSDZzDovcNuLL-jJn85Mb3gV4Sf__DsgSl_Tgum-hI9mpDWSXE8vAx_EJciUuKGeNIUeZzN1T6BsgSMtctx5lWUsUbUNNtX1af9s-hRTwFV8e8njLE7SzeGUiWd5PLZ2SnANY4NVi4Skvpo223y4xsLjrpxNWLGNL4HxKA13B9CQOayfJR3LSusr44jox5SJMWNrJVTUqCC0yOf4wD6U8lXy2OernLRYkShQesD0jCV1CotUWFYNjqhusXPt8Wra8rk89hDpp-QpfQ1_DCj6MkeiNVY5_WCogX1hqUqoaq4lFrCSeA0S8WSZqInmvN7bJ-GafucnncpEfI495j-rJUioUOnMWMxcZZoHmRdhQ%3D)**

Let's do this!

My very best,

clean_body: When I stepped off stage in New Hampshire, here is the message I shared... | | | | | Friend, When I stepped off stage in New Hampshire, here is the message I shared... You've all heard the chatter among the political class. They're falling all over themselves saying this race is over. Well, I have news for all of them. New Hampshire is first in the nation. It 's not last in the nation. This race is far from over. There are dozens of states left to go. And the next one is my sweet state of South Carolina! At one point in this campaign, there were 14 of us running, and we were at two percent in the polls. Well, I'm a fighter. Now, we're the last one standing next to Donald Trump, and today we got close to half of the vote. We still have a ways to go, but we keep moving up. For a lot of people, politics is way too personal. It's not personal for me. I decided to run because I'm worried about the future of our country, and because it's time to put the negativity and chaos behind us. We have an economy that is crushing middle-class Americans. We have a border that is totally open and dangerous, creating a disaster in our country. We have schools that are failing too many of our children. And we have a world on fire, with war in Europe and the Middle East, and a huge and growing threat from China. And then you look at Washington. We have a Congress that fights about everything and accomplishes nothing. And we have Joe Biden in the White House, making one bad decision after another, when he's making any decisions at all. Our country's in a real mess. And the question is, who 's going to fix it? With Donald Trump, Republicans have lost almost every competitive election. We lost the Senate. We lost the House. We lost the White House. We lost in 2018, in 2020 and in 2022. The worst kept secret in politics is how badly the Democrats want to run against Trump. They know Trump is the only Republican in the country who Biden can defeat. You can't fix the mess if you don't win the election. A Trump nomination is a Biden win and a Kamala Harris presidency. I defeat Biden handily. With Donald Trump, you have one bout of chaos after another. This court case, that controversy, this tweet, that senior moment. You can't fix Joe Biden's chaos with Republican chaos. The other day, Donald Trump accused me of not providing security at the Capitol on January 6th. I've long called for mental competency tests for politicians over the age of 75. Trump claims he'd do better than me on one of those tests. Maybe he would, and maybe he wouldn't. But if he thinks that, then he should have no problem standing on a debate stage with me! Most Americans do not want a rematch between Biden and Trump. The first party to retire its 80-year-old candidate is going to win this election. I say it should be the Republicans! So our fight is not over, because we have a country to save. | In the next two months, millions of voters in over 20 states will have their say. We should honor them and allow them to vote. And guess what, in the next two months, Joe Biden isn't going to get any younger or any better. We'll have all the time we need to beat Biden. When we get to South Carolina, Donald Trump is going to have a harder time falsely attacking me. The great people of South Carolina know I cut their taxes. They know I signed the toughest immigration bill in the country. They know we passed voter ID, and tort reform, and ethics reform, and they know we moved 35,000 people from welfare to work. Every time I've run for office in South Carolina, I've beaten the political establishment. They're lined up against me again. That's no surprise. But South Carolina voters don't want a coronation. They want an election. And we're going to give them one. Because we're just getting started. Let's do this! My very best, Nikki R. Hi Derek, it’s Joseph Gordon-Levitt.
This week, I was proud of Adam as he stood on the debate stage and shared his vision for a brighter future for all of us here in California.
I’m a lifelong Californian. Born in LA, raised in Sherman Oaks, and graduated from Van Nuys High School.
My parents encouraged me to be politically active from a young age. My mom, Jane Gordon, even ran for Congress here before I was born.
**And I know that no one is better prepared to serve Californians in the United States Senate than Adam.**
He doesn’t just talk the talk — there’s real action behind his words.
Like his efforts to lower prescription drug costs. Or to help secure funding for more affordable housing in our state. Or joining the SAG-AFTRA picket line, fighting alongside the labor movement for better protections for workers.
Adam showed Californians Monday night the type of Senator he will be: empathetic, strong-willed, and _effective._

Dear Friend,
As you’ve probably heard, Donald Trump won the first Republican primary last night in New Hampshire following last week’s big win at the Iowa caucus. Each day brings us closer to the likely reality of another Trump nomination. **With the November election less than nine months away, now is the time to act.**
We all know the dangers of another Trump presidency. However, my opponent, Bill Huizenga, has been and continues to be a staunch Trump supporter. **When Huizenga endorsed Trump for President last year, he sent a clear message to his constituents: that he is happy to align himself with a man who poses a serious threat to American democracy. **
Let’s show our country that Michigan’s Fourth District will NOT re-elect a man who stands behind corruption and extremism. **I need your help today to bring good governance back to West Michigan.**

name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: Enough is enough
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
I'm running out of new ways to describe just how dangerous and out of touch Trump is.
| | |
---
Friend, Trump wasn't the only one who won the New Hampshire primary last night. **Extremism won. Hatred won._And America lost._**
I'm running out of new ways to describe just how dangerous and out of touch Trump is. He wants to weaken reproductive rights and voting rights. He told grieving families to "get over" a school shooting that happened just weeks ago. He literally tried to overturn the 2020 election and stop the peaceful transition of power. And now, he's promised to "be a dictator one day one" if he's reelected.
Watching Trump's campaign as an American and a proud immigrant, I am infuriated, I am disappointed, and, truthfully, I am scared.
I grew up in Ecuador, a country where political violence was the norm. Basic concepts like safety and financial security were simply out of reach for most people. When I finally became an American citizen, it was one of the happiest and proudest days of my life. But underneath all the celebration, there was something else: **I was _safe_.**
You see, at the end of the day, the American Dream is about being safe — safe to express yourself, to exercise your freedoms, to receive an incredible education, to access health care, to build financial stability, and to have a say in the future of your country. That's a privilege that so few are afforded.

As I celebrated my new citizenship surrounded by hundreds of other cheering and crying families, **I realized that this incredible privilege came with an incredible civic responsibility to protect the American Dream that we're so lucky to enjoy.**
Today, Donald Trump and extremists like Rick Scott are attacking the American Dream. _Ya no más_. Enough is enough. We cannot let these radicals destroy the country that we've fought so hard to build. **That's why I'm running to defeat Rick Scott: so that generations of Americans can keep feeling safe the way that I finally did when I became a U.S. citizen.**
I know that this campaign has what it takes to win — polling shows our message of unity has already made this race a tie. **But Rick Scott is already spending millions to defeat us.[So please, if you believe that we have a responsibility to protect the American Dream, will you donate $25 now to help me defeat extremism and defend everything that we hold dear?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77682933/451209380/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk724-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTlmMjJjMDMtMjliYi1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=oQXwaN-IlfARxxPhbCV-GqVIcQKPvBhcq4FO-bZsPX8=)**

You may have seen her on TV, because on Monday she had her first ever first televised debate.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=36954%2E3422442%2EJE_1UE)
Hey Derek, it's Paul. My mom is Katie Porter, and she’s had a busy week!
You may have seen her on TV, because on Monday she had her first ever televised debate. I think she did awesome!! Our campaign ads are also now running in the Los Angeles TV media market, which means we also see them at our house here in Orange County.
These last few weeks before an election are always the craziest time for my mom. I know the drill, because we’ve been through this before. **In 2018, my mom had both a competitive primary and a competitive general election.** It was her first time running for office, and those were some tough races, but she pulled through and won, flipping a Republican held seat blue!
I know my mom can pull off this one too. But she’s always talking about how it’s not just her doing the work, it’s really a whole army of supporters and volunteers who get the job done.
Even though the debate is over, my mom is still busy talking with voters. She was at campaign events in LA yesterday, and later this week she’s going to the Bay Area. So I thought I could help her out by writing one of these emails. **I know she’ll be so excited if I tell her this email raised more than the normal ones.[Can you help us out?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240124-2?refcode=em20240124-36954&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36954_3422442_JE_1UE&akid=36954%2E3422442%2EJE_1UE)**

Thanks!!
Paul

subject: The key to Lincoln’s rhetorical success
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38425%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7BKYPqME2XpFrsf7D3LKUQ&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.” By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” ** Through** “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: I hope you’ll join us
body:
This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders

| | | This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5i28f6qrf2nkp96gge0igltnm47escp3e6k81d8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chge0ob4cjh2bs)
---
| |
Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zu60ajd8jkhavs9d8dguae9c5d0vdbsem10ltm70_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chge0ob4cjh2bs)

I hope you'll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

subject: Learn about the real American Founding
body:
This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders

| | | This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zals652ep45656f2mh29h8rj42frnlj1b0qossjg_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chge0ob2cjh2bs)
---
| |
Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9jil8h4bl8jveka3gf0f7afhipbn4acinvp2q20_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chge0ob2cjh2bs)

I hope you'll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: The truth is, no one knows for certain
body:
Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38424%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wABx0iPvyhVYLmL2SCcIgg&sysid=1)
---
Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38435%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vlaOh%2bY%2bo3t6oo%2fEcT9sHQ&sysid=1) I would like to send you my brand-new book _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ and my brand-new resource “The Major Characters of the End Times” as a thank you for your generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of _Pathway to Victory_.
Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38436%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8Qp%2bgYrYY70Lt9ydFxeS3g&sysid=1)

_Pathway to Victory_ is committed to equipping believers with biblical teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio, television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing the Truth of God’s Word, ____
---
| | Dr. Robert Jeffress Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas
---

name: Hillsdale College via Pro Life Update
subject: I hope you’ll join us
body:
This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders

| | | This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zvjjin3rauk124ut9p7nsu84emniqbkvjdu256r8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chge2o34cth2bs)
---
| |
Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zukbopsi4gi64qahmp1o1vf8gg0g5dkq549bhefg_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chge2o34cth2bs)

I hope you'll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

| #OHGOPSenateDebate: What They Are Saying... "Dolan Got Under Moreno's Skin..." "Dolan Definitely Was the Aggressor and Managed to Get a lot of Attention to His Positions." "Dolan's Strategy Was Clear: Repeatedly Attack Moreno & LaRose for Hypocrisy"
---
|
For Immediate Release: January 23, 2024 | [press@DolanForOhio.com](mailto:press@DolanForOhio.com)
Cleveland, OH - On Monday night, Nexstar stations across Ohio hosted the first Ohio U.S. Senate Republican Primary Debate. Dolan earned broad praise for his appearance, establishing himself from the start as the consistent conservative in the contest that Ohio Republicans can trust to defeat Sherrod Brown, fight for Ohio and get America back on the right track.
---
|
---
| [Matt Dolan, Ohio GOP Sen. Debate](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001IkRapNuuNQAHmITD9qJrGaIwPq-ITwz9_Gd8Pc9bXeuH3Z8G6RzqMCaAj_5XKkEqRiiqJdkwbDIJFqralmhm36UGe8UGffG0M_LxSNVMsveEUSYWifOzoU70I8PXZVTUMArkKjulf59w4okYX3NAfw==&c=MQeNyUrbbcE7wTXg7ZI7qq2zXrcA_QtdTf0tdNMLM4PX-vHtHjs2WA==&ch=Ke9le0GVWP1DmusAWjrP-MO3PKf0B0O5nPkVz8fh4EVpShhk31rl4w==), Jan 22, 2024
---
| "Public service jobs are about trust. Making sure that you're going to follow through on what you do ... This is about trust. Bernie we learned this week that we don't know if we can trust you. Your employees trusted you to follow a court order and do not destroy documents that helped their case against you. What did you do? You shredded those documents because it helped Bernie Moreno, not the employees. This is a matter of trust. What do we believe in, what are we going to get done and consistency. And I have been a conservative who has been consistent, and I've gotten things done," Matt Dolan said. Henry Gomez, [NBC News](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001IkRapNuuNQAHmITD9qJrGaIwPq-ITwz9_Gd8Pc9bXeuH3Z8G6RzqMCaAj_5XKkEqPH8yi2rHjYhKL1Py38L0ZWZ1SRERVQHLHArBosBcfZGEAGiqNewm7ZfUGF-LEbI8aeJD2GKdxHNJ9eA_b4ihlDC1Eq-UkJ8SkiAxC4rJjBpQfAqkWiLbaH4jLjFDpZGwQM9Ge31QWGVpmZQSKFnhWuyapRVViZ8WECvC8qbm-G_ldun3hQBwxeJ-e6QM_nwt&c=MQeNyUrbbcE7wTXg7ZI7qq2zXrcA_QtdTf0tdNMLM4PX-vHtHjs2WA==&ch=Ke9le0GVWP1DmusAWjrP-MO3PKf0B0O5nPkVz8fh4EVpShhk31rl4w==): "Dolan, who was the night's chief aggressor on stage, also asserted that, given his recent legislative experience, he is the most in sync with Trump while accusing his rivals of 'phony' reverence. 'The reality is I'm the only one in this stage who has enacted Trump policies,' Dolan said.
'These two have spent a great deal of time deleting all their past comments, hateful comments on Trump. And now, because it's in their political best interests, they're saying something completely different.' [Report](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001IkRapNuuNQAHmITD9qJrGaIwPq-ITwz9_Gd8Pc9bXeuH3Z8G6RzqMCaAj_5XKkEqPH8yi2rHjYhKL1Py38L0ZWZ1SRERVQHLHArBosBcfZGEAGiqNewm7ZfUGF-LEbI8aeJD2GKdxHNJ9eA_b4ihlDC1Eq-UkJ8SkiAxC4rJjBpQfAqkWiLbaH4jLjFDpZGwQM9Ge31QWGVpmZQSKFnhWuyapRVViZ8WECvC8qbm-G_ldun3hQBwxeJ-e6QM_nwt&c=MQeNyUrbbcE7wTXg7ZI7qq2zXrcA_QtdTf0tdNMLM4PX-vHtHjs2WA==&ch=Ke9le0GVWP1DmusAWjrP-MO3PKf0B0O5nPkVz8fh4EVpShhk31rl4w==): "Later in the debate, moderators pressed LaRose and Moreno about their shifts in rhetoric since the riot by Trump supporters at the U.S. Capitol on Jan. 6, 2021. At the time, LaRose and Moreno condemned the violence and destruction. Both have since described some of those who have been charged as political 'prisoners' -- language that echoes Trump's. Dolan slammed Moreno for a response that was sympathetic to alleged rioters. 'We just heard an absolute political phony answer,' Dolan said. 'He's trying to reinvent himself. Jan. 6 was a bad day, and I said it then. Jan. 6, was ... a bad day, and I'm saying it now.' That comment and others rankled Moreno. Andrew Tobias, [Cleveland Plain Dealer](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001IkRapNuuNQAHmITD9qJrGaIwPq-ITwz9_Gd8Pc9bXeuH3Z8G6RzqMCaAj_5XKkEqdA1ctHHP5hftvAKSoFoL6IMRUrc7oEJe8ZW9vrjI3ZBCU9E7Ns6aQKfGJo75zpK-BInv52uJgSdd9R5OQ0VZ4D9xqJxri3NwllZm9Z-QchPZ5BYRiMFFyz38KKF2Hjq7db6G0mNTNG4=&c=MQeNyUrbbcE7wTXg7ZI7qq2zXrcA_QtdTf0tdNMLM4PX-vHtHjs2WA==&ch=Ke9le0GVWP1DmusAWjrP-MO3PKf0B0O5nPkVz8fh4EVpShhk31rl4w==): "[Dolan's] strategy for tonight clearly is to repeatedly attack Moreno and LaRose for hypocrisy. # Titus Tries to Overturn the Will of the People on Abortion in Nevada
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Abortion is a settled law in Nevada. A referendum of the people passed it, which means neither the Governor nor the legislature can overturn it. Only the people of Nevada can change it. Like 71% of Americans, the people of Nevada think there should be limits on abortion. In Nevada, those limits are 24 weeks and then the life and health of the mother. Dina Titus ignored the will of the people when she voted for a federal law to allow abortion up until the day of delivery and to have the government pay for these unlimited abortions. I support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe vs Wade, not just because I'm pro-life, but because it is the correct legal decision. Even Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg stated that the Roe decision was on shaky legal ground. There is nothing in the Constitution about abortion. When the Constitution is silent on a topic, the power is vested in the States and in "We, the people." The people of Nevada have spoken. As your representative in Congress, I will not support any federal action that goes against the will of the people of my district. In the coming days leading up to the elections, you will hear Titus and others talk about abortion. They will bring it up because they don't want you thinking about inflation, the border crisis, crime, or our failing schools. Remember, the people of Nevada have already spoken on abortion - it is settled law. When career politicians in Nevada bring up abortion, they are just trying to divert your attention from their disastrous policies, which have devastated our country. Don't let them get away with it.
Mark Robertson

*******
---
Your Questions--Mark's Answers
Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently:
Q: There have been a number of arrests made, and many participants have been incarcerated for even being present at the Capitol on January 6, 2021. Yet, no such sentences were imposed during much more violent riots, which caused billions of dollars of damages to cities across the country. Do you support similar punishment for violent protestors across the country? -S.T. A. The violence and crime we witnessed by the BLM and defund the police movements were much worse than what happened on January 6th. Those people involved should have been prosecuted and incarcerated just as the January 6th rioters were..
Q. Do you support the use of federal law enforcement agents to police streets in cities with large-scale demonstrations that have sometimes turned violent? -K.L. A. No. The Federal government is already too big and intrusive. State and local law enforcement should respond to these demonstrations. Federal law enforcement should be used to protect Federal facilities like courthouses, federal offices, and military installations.
Please share this message with friends and neighbors. Have questions for me? Simply reply to this email to ask me a question.

clean_body: Abortion in Nevada-- | | | | Titus Tries to Overturn the Will of the People on Abortion in Nevada By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District Abortion is a settled law in Nevada. A referendum of the people passed it, which means neither the Governor nor the legislature can overturn it. Only the people of Nevada can change it. Like 71% of Americans, the people of Nevada think there should be limits on abortion. In Nevada, those limits are 24 weeks and then the life and health of the mother. Dina Titus ignored the will of the people when she voted for a federal law to allow abortion up until the day of delivery and to have the government pay for these unlimited abortions. I support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe vs Wade, not just because I'm pro-life, but because it is the correct legal decision. Even Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg stated that the Roe decision was on shaky legal ground. There is nothing in the Constitution about abortion. When the Constitution is silent on a topic, the power is vested in the States and in "We, the people." The people of Nevada have spoken. As your representative in Congress, I will not support any federal action that goes against the will of the people of my district. In the coming days leading up to the elections, you will hear Titus and others talk about abortion. They will bring it up because they don't want you thinking about inflation, the border crisis, crime, or our failing schools. Remember, the people of Nevada have already spoken on abortion - it is settled law. When career politicians in Nevada bring up abortion, they are just trying to divert your attention from their disastrous policies, which have devastated our country. Don't let them get away with it. Mark Robertson Your Questions--Mark's Answers Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently: Q: There have been a number of arrests made, and many participants have been incarcerated for even being present at the Capitol on January 6, 2021. Yet, no such sentences were imposed during much more violent riots, which caused billions of dollars of damages to cities across the country. Do you support similar punishment for violent protestors across the country? -S.T. A. The violence and crime we witnessed by the BLM and defund the police movements were much worse than what happened on January 6th. Those people involved should have been prosecuted and incarcerated just as the January 6th rioters were.. Q. Do you support the use of federal law enforcement agents to police streets in cities with large-scale demonstrations that have sometimes turned violent? -K.L. A. No. The Federal government is already too big and intrusive. State and local law enforcement should respond to these demonstrations. Federal law enforcement should be used to protect Federal facilities like courthouses, federal offices, and military installations. Please share this message with friends and neighbors. Have questions for me? Simply reply to this email to ask me a question. | == | == | == Mark Robertson retired from the Army. name: Hillsdale College via Trump Train News
subject: I hope you’ll join us
body:
This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders

| | | This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zljruh9c1rg6t3lmjv7coq8quqgar2frbrnj0070_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chie8oj6cjh2bs)
---
| |
Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zg39qn9g0s96s6g289sg2dp7keg8vn0bndih8v2g_rp22sh2s8i6eo33chie8oj6cjh2bs)

I hope you'll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

These words resonate deeply with me. This is Congresswoman Jen Kiggans, and I'm reaching out to you not as a polished politician but as an everyday mom and Navy veteran who is deeply passionate about securing America’s success. I've faced challenges like many of you…but in every trial, I've found strength and renewed determination to serve with a greater purpose. In the halls of Congress, far too many leaders are focused only on themselves. They only care about television interviews, making lobbyists happy, and voting the party line. But that’s NOT me! https://click.contact.jenforcongress.com/?qs=15bebdd09e45d44d7251943d1b056cfca9e7587a705c82628d35090068aaa0b837ab5dbd3f603e2bcbc1845ea65ea3d573977dbb43a11c19731bdfefddc9441e I know what real service looks like. As a former Navy helicopter pilot myself, a Navy wife, and a mom of future Navy veterans, my focus is on making sure we leave behind a safer and stronger America for my children and the next generation. I don’t care if I make any friends from the party bosses in D.C. My entire focus is and will always be on actually solving problems, standing up for our core conservative values, and fighting to make life easier for families. But as you can imagine, standing up to the establishment and not giving in to the political pressure has made me some enemies. In fact, Joe Biden’s White House has publicly attacked me, and the Democrat Congressional Campaign Committee has me at the top of their target list. Despite the attacks, I can promise you I will NEVER give up. I have the courage to fight for what’s right, and I hope you have my back. If you are tired of career politicians and want to support a new wave of conservatives who have served our country and fought for our values, then I’m humbly asking for your support today. https://click.contact.jenforcongress.com/?qs=15bebdd09e45d44d7251943d1b056cfca9e7587a705c82628d35090068aaa0b837ab5dbd3f603e2bcbc1845ea65ea3d573977dbb43a11c19731bdfefddc9441e MAKE A DONATION TODAY! I don’t care if I make any friends from the party bosses in D.C. My entire focus is and will always be on actually solving problems, standing up for our core conservative values, and fighting to make life easier for families. But as you can imagine, standing up to the establishment and not giving in to the political pressure has made me some enemies. In fact, Joe Biden’s White House has publicly attacked me, and the Democrat Congressional Campaign Committee has me at the top of their target list. Despite the attacks, I can promise you I will NEVER give up. I have the courage to fight for what’s right, and I hope you have my back. If you are tired of career politicians and want to support a new wave of conservatives who have served our country and fought for our values, then I’m humbly asking for your support today. name: Shift WA
subject: Help Stop Democrats' Outrageous Bills
body:
The Secretary of State has certified the income tax initiative
and the reasonable police pursuit initiative.

Friends,

Washington Democrats have crossed
a line that we cannot ignore.

In a shocking move, Washington
Democrats introduced House Bill 2030, which would grant felons in
prison - including notorious serial killer Gary Ridgway - the
right to vote and serve on a jury. We are not making this up -
the bill's Far-Left sponsor admitted her criminals-first approach
would extend even to the Green River Killer.

And this is just one of the many
outrageous and out-of-touch bills Democrat legislators have
brought forward in the first month of the 2024 legislative
session.

This week, State House Democrats
passed House Bill 1589 as their next step in banning natural gas
in our state. If this bill passes the Senate, it would prohibit
gas companies, particularly Puget Sound Energy (PSE), from
connecting new natural gas lines to new construction. PSE would
also no longer be obligated to provide natural gas service to
existing customers. This is an unprecedented intrusion into our
everyday lives.

But perhaps most egregiously,
Democrats seem to have adopted a mantra during this legislative
session - "If you can't let them vote, then just let them out."
Since their goal of allowing serial killers to vote may be
slipping away, they've also introduced House Bill 2001, which
would mean sentence reductions for current prisoners, by ignoring
previous criminal activity that liberals no longer consider
criminal.

It's not too late to voice your
opposition to these bills. The first legislative deadline is
approaching on January 31st, and your support can help ensure
that bills like these are stopped. You can voice your opposition
by officially commenting against these bills here: HB2030,
HB1589, and HB2001.

Shift WA is the only online
outlet you can trust to bring you the latest news from Olympia,
exposing Democrats for their terrible policies. We are committed
to keeping you informed and empowered.

To continue our efforts, we need
your support. Please consider making a donation today. Every
contribution helps us fight against these outrageous bills and
hold our elected officials accountable.

Thank you,

The Shift WA Team

P.S. Your donation is crucial in
the fight against these out-of-touch bills. Please contribute
today to support our cause.

Washington. If you would like to send this message to some of
your friends, you can click here to do so.

You can also stay up to date on
our efforts to shift the debate in Washington State by following
us on Facebook & Twitter.

Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.

Make your generous gift here: [https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2f1a04491d724ef78076e6d44d9a61cc&_e=iuDifX_kV6QKLGG-s3ljneoB_a468p00J4vVkDlw_IFsiDWJo6k9Hvh6EZDpcmOBPmf0WSJyVJMkwN5bVYxiBKGXqDD4AplKPbhv5FVreVqvzznXiNDebdjkGYf_Gkuvb5BPlePKCufyiAP7As52wvyzMJ9KPD9tfmLXqVeU3vJxJa75YgKI3vT8AYVSA-5ZbduItirktgNYeLDj1xJFWZ3CPyEpGasivj4pQFYIb0qJy9miSQJV87KzbGku48O-e5okaHiHX4GfnJ6ZwInbbJglUZkC3X9FtExRQzpfFpRvrklaSTQRDIP0x-raYPnoa084Go3p7jN5K6S6uPcf2zd0-vkrCbr70wJxYS7Jq-AG5ZhesRxeQmbPy6q0WPSwb8tGdlhXWEbi4SDmeIlFM-j_xgZMlD-hp8v7yUgTJ_QQCYK3robxQvsDRgykIWaR)

subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?
188d92cdddd40f90da47bc74ea2ba8fb

Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.

## Texas vs. Feds in Razor-Wire Standoff
Texas Gov. Greg Abbott is [fighting back](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOqzAQRb_GdCB7sCEuXLyGLq_dEo3tCczK2BF4Q_L3q92029zqHunofFznK3LivPzHjVy9lRlD5QfNqgXTgp51E92NCKhvyKlRDsqqcbTN6sgGQ1IpidBHwKiQgOxgL0Pog_exYQcStFRglDQG-s73XtqL0Rg8oDVeaEmRa9m7z8K5rnRLr_KgvQtla5Jba70fov8nYBIwnefZnXisnJdaMj1x4_y-CpjuJXF4CZh423jZsXLJAia4qEGPRsCE3pda20pPPNpEC6b2qJgj56X1ZY-0t1_5Zzk_8HjTze7i_eSU-BhGoeWyIadft_pnqe8AAAD__3s3bJ8) against the Biden administration and a U.S. Supreme Court ruling allowing Border Patrol agents to cut down razor wire put up by the state to block a stretch of the border. Abbott hasn't given way on the razor wire, and he posted [an open letter to X](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskbFu4zAMhp9G3hJIlGhZg4fg7nxTbjqg3QxJphwVdhzIbIy-fVGn3TIR4PeRBPi_nPuzz1O-jv_8TC2npfeR8516dQA8gOlNNbSJCEhX1Cora-WUta66tDElNSQcgiUdnVbSSXKpro2Pg8OmqXILEoxUgEoigj4GHaRr0PgYwDsMwkgaMi_l-LbkK18oTR_LncoxLnM1tRfm2yr0SUAnoOMtMz-YgO5vofEUwsLc_38V0K3s-X0V0CmLEjSiMQ6VNg4sCt0VSv1aotC_efuqgPiH0yYA7S_eop9vj9ZGxDQHGr4JU5l38mztQxnLLjQOAiqUIFWsSVnpa6OcbDC5gCFE8I2RdRN_Ti7XfWxVfVXa4bblacprbYWR4-zztL-AnwbyGQAA___crYIn) arguing that Texas had a "constitutional right to self-defense" because Biden had failed to secure the border. The battle could force a constitutional confrontation. Several Democrats in Congress, including Texas Rep. Joaquin Castro, called on Biden to take [control of the Texas National Guard](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFv8yAQQH8N3ojgDCEeGL7FW761o3XAOVBhiOxr0vbXV606dn5PetJ7uS5XLLW023_cyPPaF4xcHrRoCVaCWcyQ_EoENA7ktVNnPWnnpiH7dDFTGLWjURlrVIpOgUWrVwOgw-qG4kGBURqsVtbCeApjUNPFGowBcLJBGEWpcN9Pr700zrTWj_6g_RT7NlSfme-HGP8JmAXMnCmXWr-ZgDn3jRo9DwHzwcgkn8gxC5iNAQdaS6Z3PGSirccdWYaSqMmDyifJ2Bvvvf4qDbn0hlXe3nBPAuZh9-n-LLWW4-yEUbcNy0924D8HfQUAAP__L7tnrQ) if the state defies the Supreme Court order.
## Netflix Growth Soars With Broad Strategy
Netflix reported [record-high post-pandemic growth ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFyhCAQQL9GO25wBZHCIs11lzalA7joZlAusN4lf5-51CnfvObN-7jNN0eJjvXd7ThxzLMLTA-cOwFagJpVu0wREbBvceqMHDrbGWPbbRq8GsCCQqtlH7Xq0BkXFVoXfAxGtzSBBCU70J3UGvqL7720o1YueHBW-0ZJXIhzuXxmOnjDmH7yA8sl5L1N08Z8r03_1sC1gau7H_isL_WCwhQSNnA9kGOibxHzWXgTX6crjEUUrGfiKh60YBaVC7qdjlXU09dQyGMRa8lP3oRXo-zRhkWa0ZolegujV3JQMfR60KYt03J_UkpUB9Moue6O0l8h__vrNwAA__-9Mm1K)in subscribers as it shifts into more of an all-purpose destination, including everything from wrestling to old TV shows interrupted with commercials. The streaming giant said it signed up 13.1 million new subscribers in the 4th quarter, its biggest gain ever in the year's last quarter, growing to a total 260 of million global subscribers. [Here's the size of the major streaming platforms](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LuO4yAUgOGnsTssOFwcCopt3GXbLS0ux8mJsLGAxNq3H83U0__SL33_7uvdU6bj8dfv6PpWVh87fXAVDDQDtaoxuQ0RUI7oxMyNsGKe7fh0JiXQN7RoIaI1CYwOKhppk9iMlNtIDjgoLkALrjXIKcjA7U0rHwN4q8OgOCbqpU6vQkd_4pb_lw_WKZZ9zO7Z-9kG-WeAZYDluq7pQ-3tc_QndZ-p9e9wgOXNGmu9ot_peLD2Di1WClgbO2t5YexUjsa2UhlwmAdYxurSeVHO1Mw8KP7YPeWfa__V4CsAAP__FcRfAA). The financial results, added to Tuesday's announcement that Netflix had signed a 10-year, $5 billion deal to bring WWE wrestling to the service, sent the company's [stock price up by nearly 11%.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAUheGnwQ4HrqixoEhjt2lTOiBXuBmEHSBr9u0zmzr1OcU3_-dtuxmKlPyHOVG3I29mb_TATXIYOahNdU4fiIBDh1rOYpKLnOelC9qBlMYdVrlJqElNKIQTg7ODhUMYKTvSIEAJCaMU4whDbwcrlrdRmd2CWUbLlEBHLZf-K1NqAY_4zA8s_Z7PLurQ2r2y4Z3BymC9rqsv-N2w1NfOYG24h5Rj9k8Ga8J2RPrhNZtSOZqSKPnKA_kQyYfGXT4pmbQjr62gOSl5fr2-LyQXkoNisHZFu_tFMVKdZqaEPw3FP0_7t85vAAAA__8l-2dw) Netflix's premium tier, without ads, costs roughly $16 a month. With ads, the price is $6.99, but analysts point out that the strategy is bringing it back to the feel of [an old-fashioned cable channel.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhDAQRL_GdEbrxT4fhYs0dJc2JTJmgY18-AQbSP4-InWa0RSjedL7ePSPyJnX-T0-KchU-piED-qNRqfR9rYaw0SE1FQUjIebaY33bbWEmMg4azDaBDCNI1hMhINxAN6OMFUcENCCQWfAOWzqoRmgvTsb04CxdYOyQCNL2erPwqssNOWfctBWp_KsclhEXrtq3hR2CrvzPGtZ6KBtpmugsLvuFXbmqs0VFqy_G6-wW0mmzN-ady1f28rrrHmVolMcMmk5qi2Mr5Nz5v3mlYX5GTn_ceVfC78BAAD__wteW4w)
## List: What it Costs to Retire in Every State
The cost of retirement can vary by as much as $1.36 million depending on the state you live in, according to [this ranking of all 50 states](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2OtCAUQJ8Gu2vgCv4UFF9jN1-7pQG8jmxQJnhH49tvZuutT3Jycr4e08PFFPfnf7eR5SVPLnA8aVKABlBPuprtQoTUVGRVJ1s1qK4bqtU2beh7o7XX2LpFkh-kwmXuZtc12vi-ihYlaqnQKGkMNrVvvBx6o13w6AbjhZY0R86l_s5x55WWdOeTSh3yViW7Mr8O0fwTOAocr-uqw-7DBwocP2qBo1QCR2UEjmu-YHuHFba80w13fsNONANnKMSxEMQd6KRyw_uAgx1TvfKWqmLn1xVTikfbCS2fm4vpt4D__PETAAD___c3YGc). The most expensive place to retire is Hawaii, which would require over $2 million, and the least expensive is West Virginia, where you'd need less than $700,000. The analysis calculated relevant living expenses for people ages 65 or older and then multiplied them by 25 or 30 years. You can see an alphabetical ranking of retirement costs [for your state here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2OtCAUQJ8Gu2vgCv4UFF9jN1-7pQG8jmxQJnhH49tvZuutT3Jycr4e08PFFPfnf7eR5SVPLnA8aVKABlBPuprtQoTUVGRVJ1s1qK4bqtU2beh7o7XX2LpFkh-kwmXuZtc12vi-ihYlaqnQKGkMNrVvvBx6o13w6AbjhZY0R86l_s5x55WWdOeTSh3yViW7Mr8O0fwTOAocr-uqw-7DBwocP2qBo1QCR2UEjmu-YHuHFba80w13fsNONANnKMSxEMQd6KRyw_uAgx1TvfKWqmLn1xVTikfbCS2fm4vpt4D__PETAAD___c3YGc)

body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dd8296d10e7043c3b8e417f683bc08ae&_e=VjnK9CKnSa35mbPs3Ib8zxpRJnYhll_TqC8bdPpzXCVv_p88ohmIupDpP6HAhfl7ChQqnDfECfISvuQUNesPfQqmQ4wW_SbpHwvFC0Aj55_TP8oOlQcOdVQP-s_oHFaol5KSAaa61QpxPhIBWhGn76p-KvVpulKAzT7xTJJmcL20EGBEgSrw4BLbt8n5qe5KD2t1vcu3N6YP5YKzMz3K9qRrsQ74AwDXhgERZp8Vlcs6fwWGvoA1FKkpZjz445HMsRqvkkVZxJ6FSMx5s_r4qL5C-gHuviqhi6ABtfORWTazD1FXLirEMhc35I7qux7Mz55CtIKQr5HEL8BhMaEweYg5GmrcGxVwMB5RJSsAXUUpGRHWrteqyauU2Prf5MigXnZTAd9621Tjvx7rbjFapg%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dd8296d10e7043c3b8e417f683bc08ae&_e=VjnK9CKnSa35mbPs3Ib8zxpRJnYhll_TqC8bdPpzXCVv_p88ohmIupDpP6HAhfl7ChQqnDfECfISvuQUNesPfQqmQ4wW_SbpHwvFC0Aj55_TP8oOlQcOdVQP-s_oHFaol5KSAaa61QpxPhIBWhGn76p-KvVpulKAzT7xTJJmcL20EGBEgSrw4BLbt8n5qe5KD2t1vcu3N6YP5YKzMz3K9qRrsQ74AwDXhgERZp8VlcugiK5C3qzPjkaSNddLNJhEn-iGcgmPCg5NFIibWcCzlk_skanKR1wauyM-v6cJD9pyze8bOFcN84hJ-ylRetiJItsmc-rnngkShbaRbDetk8uInEoD00emX7kvyj1fAtmYZOl7KeaihHyKIXIPeE6Xy6RfUZ6qLzzkmRk6KjLbWQ%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.
