body:
I’ve never done something like this before.

Friend,

I've never done something like this before.

But right now my family is up against more than we can handle on our own. And there's nothing I won't do to protect my family - even ask a perfect stranger for help.

Next month, my beloved son - former Deputy James Johnson of the Williamson County, TX Sheriff's Department - will go on trial for manslaughter.

He faces decades in prison for doing his job by the book.

This is a photo of James with his son.
[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e57f79c554cd4f0bb0967ed7c6585bea&_e=CZvTZK-F9_Vv3DwkMH-BesY5eJ4-ct1plU23cs1Sm0Dxwb11DYPqqbLF6C9cmX8wwW2k-xi7lc5AAG6fW5H6NFpG9ckCxBoGCLA8ZiEmiOZWpubclGgL5jEgsn6_9NdBtEg5Nk5u34W-GIJx_S7p5ccbD_4fvtntcAQUvIyEdg0bgHjytZ6ssQEY3OZW3BUKSrpniCtHu3eCJFY6rs4kRi_fUBpbAUq6eyrH-b0xHjUtoxfmQjOZ69YA_gVPsMP96WyuSmy_gmfyymFyagrMLNwoVhmbqEmCtoVWpPGeCyYTF_nyEBvjKLs6-2ica_xrlFkh7KGXu5ZmNi9wcQYhYqg6V4NCYCtCijSPSiIq5NO5v6zIjheFEES32sW-cUcE)
James dreamed of being a police officer ever since he took his first "ride-along" in a cop car at the age of 18.

How could we know back then that one day he would find himself the target of a nationwide political movement directed and financed by radical anti-cop billionaire George Soros?

**[If you're sick of our men and women in blue being targeted by anti-cop prosecutors, then I pray you'll find it in your heart to help my son today.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e57f79c554cd4f0bb0967ed7c6585bea&_e=CZvTZK-F9_Vv3DwkMH-BesY5eJ4-ct1plU23cs1Sm0Dxwb11DYPqqbLF6C9cmX8wwW2k-xi7lc5AAG6fW5H6NFpG9ckCxBoGCLA8ZiEmiOZWpubclGgL5jEgsn6_9NdBtEg5Nk5u34W-GIJx_S7p5ccbD_4fvtntcAQUvIyEdg0bgHjytZ6ssQEY3OZW3BUKSrpniCtHu3eCJFY6rs4kRnruELyb0_IbReXSJX3hNNzxBffixTP16Akw3-4ML7yg1TS3YOEanTTy-ExOmcuf72glqrdeQ6iQ189ljwfGf61T1xnzlKQENBTcuxg39gV4-8ryz0h3tIn7_voBGOtbJN7-EcKvnQ_vZfsvXTxCfO14TmmnLg06zE4gjLFPVbZv)**

Please let me explain...

On the night of March 28, 2019, my son conducted a routine traffic stop.

But instead of pulling over, the driver - a convicted drug dealer named Javier Ambler - floored the gas and tried to flee.

The suspect's speed quickly exceeded 100 miles per hour. Along the way, he collided with signs, trees, fences, and other roadside objects.

The chase lasted for 22 minutes and spanned two counties. At any moment, another driver or a pedestrian could have been struck and killed by the drug dealer's reckless driving. It was a deadly serious situation.

Eventually, the chase ended when the suspect crashed head-first into a tree.

My son ordered him to get on the ground at gunpoint. He refused. James ordered again, and still the driver did not comply.

That's when another Deputy and an Austin Police Officer arrived on scene. Together, they tried to handcuff the giant man - but he kept resisting and fighting to get back on his feet.

Now, my son is strong. . . but this man was twice his size. . . **nearly 400 pounds.** And even together, the three officers could not subdue him.

So, to put a stop to his fighting and get him handcuffed, they deployed a taser again.

Still nothing - he kept resisting.

They tased him once more and they were finally able to get him into handcuffs.

That's when they noticed that the suspect had lost consciousness. Without missing a beat, they immediately began life-saving tactics and radioed for an ambulance to respond with high priority.

The suspect was rushed to the hospital - but despite the prompt medical attention, he was declared dead on arrival.

According to the medical examiner, Javier Ambler's "morbid obesity" had given him "congestive heart failure" and "hyper intensive cardiovascular disease," - which, in the heat of the struggle, caused his death.

Soon after, an internal affairs investigation by my son's department found that the deputies did nothing wrong. A second independent investigation by the Austin Police Department concluded my son and the other officers committed no such crimes and did not cause Ambler's death.

**But two years after being cleared, James was charged with manslaughter!**

So what changed?

Well, Travis County - where the suspect crashed and the chase concluded - elected a new District Attorney.

A George Soros-funded District Attorney . . . a Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren-endorsed District Attorney . . . a socialist District Attorney, who campaigned not on fighting crime - but on cracking down on police.

His name is Jose Garza, and in just over three years in office, he's charged dozens of cops with crimes while letting countless violent criminals go free!

Somehow, my son James got caught up in something much bigger than himself, and now he's lost his job and his life savings trying to defend his good name in court.

Worst of all, if convicted James's children will lose their dad to decades in prison.

**[Now I hope you can see why I'm swallowing my pride and asking you to help me fight for my son - and my grandchildren - by supporting James' legal defense.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e57f79c554cd4f0bb0967ed7c6585bea&_e=CZvTZK-F9_Vv3DwkMH-BesY5eJ4-ct1plU23cs1Sm0Dxwb11DYPqqbLF6C9cmX8wwW2k-xi7lc5AAG6fW5H6NFpG9ckCxBoGCLA8ZiEmiOZWpubclGgL5jEgsn6_9NdBtEg5Nk5u34W-GIJx_S7p5ccbD_4fvtntcAQUvIyEdg0bgHjytZ6ssQEY3OZW3BUKSrpniCtHu3eCJFY6rs4kRrq7dW8TUUphB8uibriZ2kIw8jg_Oy47Wrs7H0-GbGp_MOE0d-jZYo57t3F_puC7MmO3SADOw2y2HhfzvaovnKnuTCi1c5F8P7aXOY5HdEsc9IEV98GaDcKgczfWhRRSUbbwNDgX7P1wsMkkQKszT5nVnj6lBn4aTqJSoeIInLMM)**

You see, right when we thought all hope was lost - we got a call from Jason Johnson at the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF).

This incredible organization helps innocent cops who are unfairly prosecuted for split-second, life-or-death decisions they make in the line of duty.

They provide legal counsel, expert witnesses. . . whatever is needed to make sure wrongly accused police officers get a fair shake in court.

And they do it all free of charge!

They're funded entirely by the generous support of big-hearted donors like you, who can recognize a miscarriage of justice. . . and want to help fix it.

My son has told me he feels abandoned by the people he dedicated his life to helping. I told him there are people out there who still support the police...

...and I pray you are one of these people and that you will step up and help to fund the $150,000+ in legal fees he's facing.

**[Will you please help my son clear his name by making a generous tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100 or more to LELDF today?](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e57f79c554cd4f0bb0967ed7c6585bea&_e=CZvTZK-F9_Vv3DwkMH-BesY5eJ4-ct1plU23cs1Sm0Dxwb11DYPqqbLF6C9cmX8wwW2k-xi7lc5AAG6fW5H6NFpG9ckCxBoGCLA8ZiEmiOZWpubclGgL5jEgsn6_9NdBtEg5Nk5u34W-GIJx_S7p5ccbD_4fvtntcAQUvIyEdg0bgHjytZ6ssQEY3OZW3BUKSrpniCtHu3eCJFY6rs4kRhFVw2rUzzyqPV7hhTEBxx7tUKWIAFh46DH61vYPpTxp-oZZgDNTGebgzXZXr8M3OQwsh0maMNrStierfR-c4H4CoN1gPI8oMVDnDGXoz67R8mLgcZ6Qrue6hJDPRu3uq5bpRaNmilwfubOjS2fVyoMpwsjCquqsz0583uOemJyS)**

No matter how much you can give to help LELDF fund James' defense, I hope you'll know how grateful I - and my entire family - will be for your help.

With deep appreciation,

**Karen Dabney**

P.S. My son has four children of his own. If James is convicted and receives the maximum sentence of 20 years, they'll be grown adults by the time he's finally set free. He will miss out on everything. And his children will grow up without a dad.

**[So, please- PLEASE - won't you send the best donation you can today to help keep my brave son out of prison and with his children, where he belongs?](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e57f79c554cd4f0bb0967ed7c6585bea&_e=CZvTZK-F9_Vv3DwkMH-BesY5eJ4-ct1plU23cs1Sm0Dxwb11DYPqqbLF6C9cmX8wwW2k-xi7lc5AAG6fW5H6NFpG9ckCxBoGCLA8ZiEmiOZWpubclGgL5jEgsn6_9NdBtEg5Nk5u34W-GIJx_S7p5ccbD_4fvtntcAQUvIyEdg0bgHjytZ6ssQEY3OZW3BUKSrpniCtHu3eCJFY6rs4kRqGrxrVTgsv4Oy8A94DdQ-nIkzCELfbIcaBe6rv1H84tFGbumuia_KzDbLPw-tSczinP44IEQljSOhboTncWc3GdbGMDFyWJcYHf-oCDs5Ar7A6tLhM3LHQTh2qMT4UmptnPBb_Lk--U7gnk1fBS9Vuj84zdLxBOj_Jyvgkq7EP8)** Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, THANK YOU!
\----------------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_

subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=dcae6c9672be47a6a5cb2832a19fe106&_e=ttcABFzdUjzy1210Uy9twOTL__RWnRtboI1OzqfT6CMdUN0moi99CouLpoiFHyRelXUF27yXLrFUbZfmpUcOhnoun7BQd_1cfyItCytyeDf_F7K17wdLSnpdWGZOi2qm98FcL8P_SZyNcKhA4T6trOvEpEwG_5wccEa6LfETqZJkRUaWp7UqJaYyg0_3qX-CAZM2eCUvN-yU-1by30TkyManiKfXTwvSOFPmWyMLRIcxnQ-3RC5-KkswUtQ1t9EmTCHgxQ2hxmrtXwNKX4XY7iMwiT3lLwhJn9nhIHlAT9U9xb5TYznDc1GTXC_hvgSxUdtJV6L4KbhAs-ecm_geMDsXOPc6cq5ip_rSJc7X1-bpKBF7D0QR4sknuvvCb3zGqNot0MDFr8150O4cgHQj6A%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=dcae6c9672be47a6a5cb2832a19fe106&_e=ttcABFzdUjzy1210Uy9twOTL__RWnRtboI1OzqfT6CMdUN0moi99CouLpoiFHyRelXUF27yXLrFUbZfmpUcOhnoun7BQd_1cfyItCytyeDf_F7K17wdLSnpdWGZOi2qm98FcL8P_SZyNcKhA4T6trOvEpEwG_5wccEa6LfETqZJkRUaWp7UqJaYyg0_3qX-CAZM2eCUvN-yU-1by30TkyManiKfXTwvSOFPmWyMLRIcuhOJbbdjo2lYiTI51U2ePSJFtEplgrhLdvwkcof1jyNbzaQ-9hlDLGRhcwC1eOMvNI2hHSSCHpuv73GqDwq91gHDyEevmVIgBRV1zzBeqo30iuEABMPZ1UDo_pb6oa4B7X8GfdRWcQbDuElvvw7iyDOLBeO9WrHUlU-ILwdxlzg%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=dcae6c9672be47a6a5cb2832a19fe106&_e=ttcABFzdUjzy1210Uy9twOTL__RWnRtboI1OzqfT6CMdUN0moi99CouLpoiFHyRelXUF27yXLrFUbZfmpUcOhnoun7BQd_1cfyItCytyeDf_F7K17wdLSnpdWGZOi2qm98FcL8P_SZyNcKhA4T6trOvEpEwG_5wccEa6LfETqZJkRUaWp7UqJaYyg0_3qX-CAZM2eCUvN-yU-1by30TkyManiKfXTwvSOFPmWyMLRIfuv8KgZD9cPnaiqAQMEwOpOHjxnvIZrtBd-iMMTH5cx6Hfzr85izTWtjHEvLv2bLJPiQsrAQu-z8o-10Ea2umah4TXFLA58x9730t09K_WtHssXBE_C6rhXkhCi6U6t4vjVfazsWWGORNCIvhsBP91uLyiVttSQurfUVvXtmfJuQ%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

Hello Friend,

Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things rather than our Creator.

Have you ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings, our Savior, will return.

That's the heart of Revelation.

Each day on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale. Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is near.

This isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about revealing Jesus Christ.

When Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns, that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's Revelation's essence.

As the great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of our King.

In my brand-new book, _Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's Future Plans_ , I tackle five common questions about the end times. We'll delve into:

1\. America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the Antichrist?
2\. The Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this apocalyptic event?
3\. The Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4\. Gog and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their appearance?
5\. The Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the unsure.

In addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.

subject: The key to Lincoln's rhetorical success
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
188d92cdddd40f90da47bc74ea2ba8fb
This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/3HRsvZhS16IbP_Y6eUM_dA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnlPOIP0S-~~)
---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---

Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/3HRsvZhS16IbP_Y6eUM_dA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnlPOIP0S-~~)

Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Citizens Fund
subject: Urgent: Make sure Donald Trump is on the ballot
body:
Don’t let the Left choose who is on the ballot
| | | |
---
|
---
| Patriot–

---
| I want to discuss a matter of the utmost importance regarding the 2024 election with you. Election winners are supposed to represent the will of the people, and therefore have the consent of the governed. It is with this principle in mind that I bring to your attention the attacks to keep Donald Trump's off of the 2024 election ballot. Getting candidates kicked off the ballot under false pretenses is the go-to tactic for Left. This way, they don’t have to face the fight against a strong opponent and risk losing. Donald Trump is the latest target of this tactic. Voters have the right to express [their support for Donald Trump](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb979467104f36/1edb9794670e2572 "their support for Donald Trump") at the ballot box. By depriving voters of the choice to vote for him – not because he lost the primary, a legitimate reason a candidate is no longer on the ballot – the Left is deciding the outcome of the election by force and deceit, not voters. It’s akin to one football team forcibly choosing their rival team’s quarterback. It doesn’t matter how much one side despises the candidate on the other side; they don’t get to pick who is allowed to be on the ballot. The most any one of us can do is campaign against the candidate and vote for our top choice. We fully understand that ensuring Donald Trump's name is on the ballot is not only a matter of personal preference but also a commitment to preserving the foundational principles of our nation that make us strong and free. To achieve this goal, we need your support. Here's how you can get involved:
1. **Spread the Word:** Share information about the importance of a free and fair election with your friends, family, and social networks. Encourage open dialogue about the significance of having Donald Trump on the ballot.

2. **Volunteer :** [Join our team of dedicated volunteers](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb979467104f36/1edb9794670e2574 "Join our team of dedicated volunteers") working tirelessly to gather signatures, raise awareness, and engage with communities to ensure Donald Trump's candidacy is given the consideration it deserves.

3. **Donate :** Financial contributions play a crucial role in supporting the logistical aspects of a campaign. [Your donations](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb979467104f36/1edb9794670e2576 "Your donations") will go towards petition drives, advertising to educate the public, and other essential resources needed to secure Donald Trump's place on the ballot.
Your commitment to this cause is vital, and your efforts will contribute to upholding the values we hold dear. subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e6dcadd19b70411c907387f4db2e46a6&_e=rLlWrfTIYgbHzCqUjw0T2imyStqHmxuClF87s-HmsjYDGbqIT8q3N2eCOcCm0MjllysKeQw-DYBWnBvvQMr6_KI-yir_L68fav72NG4CX2hxcewvUC3Ql1jA1z-6JbJkNplgv7ethBZelp_Dmy-i8vdEOWzXu8G8kSQxYlESQ0gKflu8-J85lBiOFWx-Yj111GVxZ4wdvoj3ss-SCwB-_g-3gLJeBnwthFaUpF9C_Ju7ljhWnqR-7aXuJRvSkQiM_moVn4HYUnNMRdQXRSwAa1S1HgUNwum2rmlOeHEXuVK62WuzngKfO5SyVg4XjH22Ud-t6m3Qg38pNUXbPlGCmBAgU-FQmrLObPza4sUbhXtWluhkPykV6eXbte0L40TfMy02sAC_5NB-ZHl15_9Atg%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e6dcadd19b70411c907387f4db2e46a6&_e=rLlWrfTIYgbHzCqUjw0T2imyStqHmxuClF87s-HmsjYDGbqIT8q3N2eCOcCm0MjllysKeQw-DYBWnBvvQMr6_KI-yir_L68fav72NG4CX2hxcewvUC3Ql1jA1z-6JbJkNplgv7ethBZelp_Dmy-i8vdEOWzXu8G8kSQxYlESQ0gKflu8-J85lBiOFWx-Yj111GVxZ4wdvoj3ss-SCwB-_g-3gLJeBnwthFaUpF9C_JvvHD7Lc4pzR_0MU3jDdJTBetZmz2b8PGpQ6O7mIOMi5K9EOFp0kZb3Iu_ghYhJr35mzmOK23dTxi_YGFNPuOxMlxSnI0tISjrA9JD0Sqm0jMKLS-I2tIlvZXsJ4wVmQU9XdQgBzjoZytxE72nVi3aOaZjF-oZNXJqbMOcFglAC6w%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e6dcadd19b70411c907387f4db2e46a6&_e=rLlWrfTIYgbHzCqUjw0T2imyStqHmxuClF87s-HmsjYDGbqIT8q3N2eCOcCm0MjllysKeQw-DYBWnBvvQMr6_KI-yir_L68fav72NG4CX2hxcewvUC3Ql1jA1z-6JbJkNplgv7ethBZelp_Dmy-i8vdEOWzXu8G8kSQxYlESQ0gKflu8-J85lBiOFWx-Yj111GVxZ4wdvoj3ss-SCwB-_g-3gLJeBnwthFaUpF9C_JuN66ahg93hSYxkW0srDYgUmfkB3_R3fsxGI9SKZ8Xh1Qte7guZgaPDqxoyb6gfOzw4hUuigta63p8KYTtOcOe_D0AR4RPWL_Y53ad7NalV29jGiSKA3-wv_ZYDMXzdhXBmjN-B1mO66oSD7qO4m0x5GTZlUwD6X1nhTp7bPASb7g%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Dear Peter,
The breaking news that a Canadian Court is forcing psychiatrist Jordan Peterson to undergo state-sanctioned media training because of “demeaning” social media posts is an assault to the fundamental tenets of Democracy and Freedom.
Authoritarianism was tried by many nations in the 20th century, and it failed every single time—because people of the free world opposed those regimes that sought to terminate fundamental human rights.
That a Canadian court would force anyone to submit to their speech codes or else lose his or her ability to earn a living more resembles Communist-led China, not a free nation.
In fact, our campaign is currently facing mainstream media censorship, social media companies throttling down our news stories and events, and two hostile political parties who want us eliminated.
One party, the Democrats, have fully embraced censorship of those who don’t toe the line and hold to their narrative. Many Republicans also push back against those like Robert F. Kennedy Jr., who take on the military-iIndustrial Complex and never-ending wars.
_Both parties will stop at nothing to ensure their collective uniparty agenda is accomplished._
You and I simply do not count.
We the People are not on their agenda.
That the middle class is decimated, that the cost of housing is out of reach for most of us, that our jobs no longer pay us a living wage, that our test scores rank dead last among free nations and trap our children in perpetual mediocrity, that life expectancy is dropping, that drug use and the death rates from drug overdoses and suicide are at record highs...
**_...the politicians from both parties do not give a damn about you or me._**
The United States of America is sick and in need of a miracle cure.
The cure begins with honesty and a commitment to our shared American values: free speech, the Constitution, transparency, and accountability.
And each one of us has a unique opportunity, right now, to stand up for what we know is right. We can support one another, encourage one another, and stand alongside one another to see that a new vision, a new voice, and a new direction comes to fruition—centered first and foremost on We The People.
Benjamin Franklin, referring to the great risk our Founding Fathers took when they fought for their Independence, said: “Either we stand together or we hang separately.”
_This campaign is asking, and will continue to ask, a lot from each of you._ We need contributions, both large and small. We need volunteers, full-time and part-time. We need advocates. We need door knockers and people making phone calls.
The easiest part is donating. The maximum amount an individual can donate to support Robert F Kennedy Jr. for President is $6,600, and there is no minimum gift.

First and foremost, we must ensure RFK Jr.'s name is on the ballot in all 50 states.

Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our National Survey on the Department of Justice and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached National Survey on the Department of Justice , which you can access at this secure link: Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. # [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1061%2E135344%2EIk08zM)

Friends -
Team Slotkin has a bit of an unofficial motto: low ego, no drama, just get stuff done. (OK, sometimes we use a different word for “stuff.”)
When most people think about politics and the House of Representatives, those aren’t exactly the words that come to mind.
And it’s true. There are a lot of egos in politics (trust me on that!), and a ton of drama, and that can prevent us from focusing on the work and getting stuff done.
It helps that I didn’t start my career as a politician, or with any aspiration to run for office. I spent decades in public service, from the CIA to the White House to the Pentagon. I served three tours overseas alongside our military. And especially when you’re serving in a warzone, it doesn’t matter what political party you come from. What matters is whether you’re focused on the mission at hand.
I’ve long believed that public service is the greatest love letter you can send to your country. When 9/11 happened, I started working in national security because I believed it was the best way I could serve my country. Years later, I ran for office for the very same reason.
There’s a lot of cynicism about politics, and it’s easy to see why. But not everyone thinks the feuds and nastiness of Washington is the way it should be. I’ll always be a public servant and hold on to my motto: low ego, no drama, mission first.
[**This is why I am running to represent Michigan in the U.S. Senate. But I can’t get there without your help. Your willingness to help chip in to elect a Senator who believes in public service would mean the world to us.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-jan24.--Kpen&refcode=em240125-1-325k&t=2&akid=1061%2E135344%2EIk08zM)**

body:

Friend, I’m the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran. I was taught the values of hard work, determination, and persistence from a young age.
I carried these values with me when I was working as a cocktail waitress at Caesars Palace to help pay for college and, later, when I was a computer programmer in a male-dominated field. Today, I carry these values with me as I work in the U.S. Senate.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77698270/451239386/-1853236879?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3362-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MDY2ZDFlMS04Y2JiLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RG3ea-lcpyS_gVl2WFtqet0MJOpD-rDzAopQgRejmh8=)
Though my path to serving in Congress was anything but traditional, my unique experiences have made me especially committed to fighting for real progress for working families in Nevada and across the country. **But right now, I need your help.**
**_CNN_ is calling me one of the most vulnerable senators in the country, and Mitch McConnell has personally recruited a far-right Republican to defeat me in the race that will decide Senate control. And now, a shady MAGA billionaire has poured $2 MILLION into Nevada to help McConnell flip this battleground seat red.**
**I don’t like reaching out to you for help like this, friend, but I will always do whatever it takes to keep up the fight for working families.[That’s why I need to humbly ask for your support to hit my critical $10,000 midnight fundraising goal: Will you please give $5 or more now to keep Nevada and the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77698272/451239388/-1853236879?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3362-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MDY2ZDFlMS04Y2JiLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RG3ea-lcpyS_gVl2WFtqet0MJOpD-rDzAopQgRejmh8=)**

body:
Some important updates about our campaign
#
Hey Peter, it’s Caleb, Lucas Kunce’s campaign manager.
I don’t reach out like this very often, but I wanted to share a few important updates before I ask you to chip in toward our $300,000 end-of-month goal.
**[CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43103?refcode=em20240125-4676&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4676%2E614464%2E74rMp8)**
Since I last updated you in September, our campaign has been firing on all cylinders — holding Josh Hawley accountable, getting Lucas out across the state, and, with your support, continuing to build a record-breaking grassroots movement.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43103?refcode=em20240125-4676&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4676%2E614464%2E74rMp8)
We already had the first poll showing Lucas and Hawley in a dead heat, but just days after major victories for red-state Democrats and abortion rights in Kentucky and Ohio, we got something we didn’t expect — another new public poll confirming that Lucas and Hawley are in a _statistical tie_ for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43103?refcode=em20240125-4676&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4676%2E614464%2E74rMp8)
Lucas earned major endorsements from critical in-state organizations throughout the last 12 months, including the Missouri AFL-CIO and the Missouri Fire Fighters, who threw their support behind Lucas earlier than they ever had before for a Senate challenger.
But these new polls put a national spotlight on our race, and key organizations like End Citizens United // Let America Vote and League of Conservation Voters officially weighed in on our race by endorsing Lucas:
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43103?refcode=em20240125-4676&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=4676%2E614464%2E74rMp8)
Meanwhile, Hawley’s approval polling — which was already pretty dismal — continued to get even worse. The latest reporting from _Morning Consult_ confirmed that Hawley remains the least popular GOP U.S. Senator up for re-election this year, with numbers even lower than Senators Ted Cruz in Texas and Rick Scott in Florida.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43103?refcode=em20240125-4676&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=4676%2E614464%2E74rMp8)
Now, it’s January 2024, and we’re on track to have one of our best months yet.
We started off with a bang by holding Josh Hawley accountable on the three-year anniversary of his infamous cowardice on January 6th. Then, with the announcement of a new ballot initiative to enshrine abortion rights in Missouri, we harnessed the energy of our grassroots movement and raised thousands of dollars to help Missourians for Constitutional Freedom get off the ground.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43103?refcode=em20240125-4676&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=4676%2E614464%2E74rMp8)
Our grassroots momentum is undeniable. That’s why national insiders and corporate elites have already spent BIG to prop up Hawley’s campaign. **They know Lucas isn’t afraid to stand up to their broken status quo — and they know that Lucas’ message is exactly what we need to take back power for working families in this election.**
But I’ll be honest, Peter. As we await Q4 reports to be filed with the FEC on the last day of this month, I’m getting nervous about what we’ll see on Hawley’s report.
Those pro-Hawley DC insiders made significant investments into our race last year, through transfers to Hawley’s campaign and through a brand new Super PAC they’ve already funded with more than $1 MILLION. And after our campaign gained so much momentum, we know they’re only going to ramp up their spending and attacks.
It has never been more important for our campaign to stay prepared. **That’s why today, I’m reaching out to ask you to contribute to our most aggressive monthly goal yet — $300,000 raised online before the end of January.**
**[Can Lucas count on you to chip in a donation of any amount right now to help us reach this goal, fight back against the insiders trying to buy this seat, and defeat Josh Hawley this November? This is our chance to take Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat back for working families — and we can’t afford to waste it.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43103?refcode=em20240125-4676&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=4676%2E614464%2E74rMp8)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43104?refcode=em20240125-4676&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=8&akid=4676%2E614464%2E74rMp8) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43104?refcode=em20240125-4676&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=9&akid=4676%2E614464%2E74rMp8) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43104?refcode=em20240125-4676&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=10&akid=4676%2E614464%2E74rMp8) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43104?refcode=em20240125-4676&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=11&akid=4676%2E614464%2E74rMp8) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43104?refcode=em20240125-4676&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=12&akid=4676%2E614464%2E74rMp8) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43104?refcode=em20240125-4676&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=13&akid=4676%2E614464%2E74rMp8) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43103?refcode=em20240125-4676&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=14&akid=4676%2E614464%2E74rMp8)

I don’t reach out like this very often, but I wanted to share a few important updates before I ask you to chip in toward our $300,000 end-of-month goal. Since I last updated you in September, our campaign has been firing on all cylinders — holding Josh Hawley accountable, getting Lucas out across the state, and, with your support, continuing to build a record-breaking grassroots movement. We already had the first poll showing Lucas and Hawley in a dead heat, but just days after major victories for red-state Democrats and abortion rights in Kentucky and Ohio, we got something we didn’t expect — another new public poll confirming that Lucas and Hawley are in a statistical tie for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat. Lucas earned major endorsements from critical in-state organizations throughout the last 12 months, including the Missouri AFL-CIO and the Missouri Fire Fighters, who threw their support behind Lucas earlier than they ever had before for a Senate challenger. But these new polls put a national spotlight on our race, and key organizations like End Citizens United // Let America Vote and League of Conservation Voters officially weighed in on our race by endorsing Lucas: Meanwhile, Hawley’s approval polling — which was already pretty dismal — continued to get even worse. The latest reporting from Morning Consult confirmed that Hawley remains the least popular GOP U.S. Senator up for re-election this year, with numbers even lower than Senators Ted Cruz in Texas and Rick Scott in Florida. Now, it’s January 2024, and we’re on track to have one of our best months yet. We started off with a bang by holding Josh Hawley accountable on the three-year anniversary of his infamous cowardice on January 6th. Then, with the announcement of a new ballot initiative to enshrine abortion rights in Missouri, we harnessed the energy of our grassroots movement and raised thousands of dollars to help Missourians for Constitutional Freedom get off the ground. body:
https://www.wbur.org/onpoint/2024/01/17/ai-influence-election-2024-politics [https://www.wbur.org/onpoint/2024/01/17/ai-influence-election-2024-politics]
Dear Friend
Last month our campaign made international news [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/12/12/democratic-campaign-ai-caller-00131180] when we became the first campaign in the world to use a voice-powered artificial intelligence agent ("Ashley") to reach voters. At that time, there was a lot of discussion about the ethical implications of using AI in political campaigns. My team and I thought long and hard about those ethical questions, and decided that we wanted to lead from the front by utilizing this cutting edge technology in a way that is fully ethical, truthful and transparent.
In the last week, the deceitful and unethical use of this kind of technology has made its own headlines. These stories have highlighted the need for ethical leadership, and a recent story on NPR acknowledged our campaign's leadership on this important issue.
I'm reaching out today to ask you to support my campaign so that I can continue to provide the leadership we need on this issue as a candidate, and as a member of Congress.

body:
The Virgin Islands has never seen this kind of attention. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/73483f4439b8/re-hey-9343501?e=d30db4cde8)
---
| |
---
| | **2024 VIRGIN ISLANDS CAUCUS | FEBRUARY 8 ** **St. Croix: 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. at La Reine Chicken Shack, Christiansted
St. John: 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. at Lovango Rum Bar, Cruz Bay
St. Thomas: 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. at Bluebeard's Castle, Charlotte Amalie**
Fellow Republican,
The amount of positive press coverage the Virgin Islands and our Republican Party has received for hosting 2024 presidential candidate Nikki Haley is unprecedented.
It's not just the story in today's [Daily News](https://protonmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9e6c445a9ccf2aeca06760698&id=fd53ee34de&e=d30db4cde8) or the [Consortium](https://protonmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9e6c445a9ccf2aeca06760698&id=5e4a0555bd&e=d30db4cde8).
Haley's appearance in the Virgin Islands ahead of the caucus on February was also covered by [The New York Times](https://protonmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9e6c445a9ccf2aeca06760698&id=9bcefa7147&e=d30db4cde8), [The Washington Post](https://protonmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9e6c445a9ccf2aeca06760698&id=91d89e9919&e=d30db4cde8), [The Washington Examiner](https://protonmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9e6c445a9ccf2aeca06760698&id=41d9e6d3cd&e=d30db4cde8), the Associated Press, ABC, CBS and others. Of course, [it also made ](https://protonmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9e6c445a9ccf2aeca06760698&id=633d761bde&e=d30db4cde8)[the local TV news](https://protonmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9e6c445a9ccf2aeca06760698&id=683ecdf6c0&e=d30db4cde8). Folks, it would be difficult to buy the kind of we received.

After yesterday's event, Haley said on Twitter/X that her vision for America includes "ALL of America," including the Virgin Islands.

I need you to show up and vote on February 8. We need our voices heard loud and clear. After all, [the caucus](https://protonmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9e6c445a9ccf2aeca06760698&id=ca397c790c&e=d30db4cde8) is our only vote for president in 2024 since U.S. territories can't vote in the general election.

We have Commit to Caucus receptions tomorrow (Friday) on St. Croix and then Saturday on St. Croix with Congressman Wesley Hunt, who former President Donald J. Trump is sending down to personally represent him.

**The St. Thomas Commit to Caucus reception with Hunt and Virgin Islands Senator Alma Francis Heyliger is 6 p.m. Friday** Just reply to this email and I'll share the location. (It's at a private house.)

**The St. Croix Commit to Caucus reception with Hunt is 10 a.m. Saturday** at The Palms at Pelican Cove in Christiansted.

I hope to see you Friday or Saturday,

Republican Chairman Gordon Ackley

Support for Judicial Watch by committed patriots like you has _never been more important than it is today!_
**Because****right now we are carrying the largest and most important caseload in our 30-year history ...and making a major impact for the rule of law!**

| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=66737&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Here's why we need your help now.

**_We continue to fight for honest elections_ ... **

We have "warned" **Illinois** and **California** that we are ready to sue them if they don't take steps to clean their voter rolls as required by federal law (Illinois) and if they don't live up to all the terms of a previous voter roll settlement with Judicial Watch (California), while we are also in court against **Illinois** over its reckless law permitting ballots to be counted up to two weeks _after_ Election Day...which opens wide the door to voter fraud!

And just a few days ago, we filed (with our friends at the Allied Education Foundation) a "_friend_ _of the court_ " brief in the **U.S. Supreme Court** in support of former President Trump's challenge to the Colorado Supreme Court's unprecedented decision to remove him from the 2024 presidential primary ballot.

The challenges to honest elections are enormous... _and ongoing,_ which is why [your support today is so critically needed!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=66737&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=66737&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

**_We are exposing the blatant targeting of traditional Catholics by the corrupt and politically-driven Biden FBI._**

In response to a Judicial Watch lawsuit, the **FBI** was forced to release documents showing that the agency's Office of General Counsel reviewed the targeting of traditional Catholics by the agency's Richmond field office...and that contrary to statements by **FBI Director Christopher Wray** , other field offices were involved in this spy operation!

It also seems that this scheme was approved by top lawyers at the FBI...which makes this scandal targeting law-abiding Americans even more frightening!

[You can count on Judicial Watch to keep fighting to get to all the facts...and to accountability!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=66737&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=66737&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

**_And we keep fighting to stop the Left from enacting laws and programs that create discrimination in America_**.

We have been given the green light in our historic lawsuit in **Minnesota** on behalf of a **Minneapolis** taxpayer challenging a teachers' contract that provides discriminatory job protections to certain racial minorities.

Judicial Watch believes that no discrimination means no discrimination!

[Your contribution today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=66737&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2) will help us keep fighting the Left's efforts to overturn our laws against discrimination based on race, gender or ethnicity to in order to advance their woke agenda!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=66737&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

_Thanks to our members’ generous support_ , Judicial Watch is doing that the Department of Justice, Congress and the Dominant Media should be doing... _but won 't_!

**And as I said before, we are carrying** the largest and most important caseload in our history... _and your decision to make a contribution and give us your support is vital to our continued success_.

Thank you for your commitment to our shared values, and the rule of law. I hope I can count on [you to to support Judicial Watch with a contribution today!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=66737&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)

Sincerely,

Thomas Fitton

| Gold Dome Download January 25, 2024
Welcome to this year's first issue of the Gold Dome Download, your source for insights into legislative priorities at the State Capitol. As we step into 2024, our goal is to keep you informed about the major initiatives under consideration by state lawmakers - as well as the latest news in key areas like election integrity, education, public safety, and economic development.
This year marks the second convening of the 157th Georgia General Assembly, which gaveled in on January 8th. We're just a few weeks in, and already lawmakers have brought forward a number of major bills that are making headlines.
---
|
---
| Governor's Priorities In his State of the State Address, Governor Kemp highlighted a number of his legislative priorities for 2024. View our summary below or click [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XGRnd_FLTbzvX9Brzv_safE0khwp1dgYzzyX5OlhTeMvGTFdMEXsbLlOlpnvghw8z9L0VCcyrTyS63LpKNFR9IelLonD_KRkaH7OkKQzyEhi04gxXgzMW-U_jxaQpoK0QrXlAHYlF6sfVilI6nF2nrktUuafXYZMmbsJYcEGkmAU6_Lha5cKAutKBoi-NLYiCesEC3pRr7fxQKH3dEbOtj-dNSaEd1p5CNH80lq8SSVttqc4BZWuaQ==&c=mZU7gHMOxRaB6RAxg3l-BDSES-hqb23BP81SN0_0dosgO5Vh338T1g==&ch=PgX6STqWV1X076nmQwIbn1qcMD9v8UPgyjaV3ucOzfaV_KHM7JwmDw==) to read his full remarks.
Cutting Taxes
* Accelerating the existing state income tax cuts to bring even more savings to Georgia taxpayers (the 2024 rate will be lowered to 5.39%, saving taxpayers an estimated $1.1 billion this year alone)

Infrastructure
* $1.8B allocated to improve Georgia's infrastructure

Education
* Passing a school choice bill
* Increasing teacher salaries ($2,500)
* $104 million for school safety improvements

Public Safety
* Increasing law enforcement salaries ($3,000)
* Supporting the Atlanta Public Safety Training Center

Healthcare
* $1.6B for mental health programs
* Continued investment to improve the private sector insurance exchange

### Senator Max Burns (R-SD23)
Senator Burns represents the 23rd Senate District, which covers several counties including Burke, Emanuel, Glascock, Jefferson, Jenkins, Johnson, McDuffie, Screven, Taliaferro and Warren. He serves as the Chairman of the Ethics Committee, Vice Chair of Higher Education, and is a member of the Children and Families and Agriculture and Consumer Affairs Committees. Senator Burns is the sponsor of numerous election bills, most notably SB358, the bill to remove the Secretary of State from the State Election Board - which passed a Senate committee this week.
To learn more about Senator Burns, [CLICK HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XGRnd_FLTbzvX9Brzv_safE0khwp1dgYzzyX5OlhTeMvGTFdMEXsbLlOlpnvghw8so4WkLyk-h6GMVMyp5dPebclh_hLrw2xa6s5mVXJnJojEsY_hFfbUR7pg9jZ56OUayELm_VRTK9DPY1l54ceKn50tKyIBWV6_ZS3AbQvN4JsJOxFSi6VAazbBxSicvoeh8aiMHpSfB0=&c=mZU7gHMOxRaB6RAxg3l-BDSES-hqb23BP81SN0_0dosgO5Vh338T1g==&ch=PgX6STqWV1X076nmQwIbn1qcMD9v8UPgyjaV3ucOzfaV_KHM7JwmDw==).

### Rep. Joseph Gullett (R-HD19)
Representative Gullet serves the people of the 19th House District which encompasses part of Paulding County. He serves as the Vice Chair of Code Revision and as a member on Appropriations, Banks & Banking, Energy, Utilities & Telecommunications, Governmental Affairs, Insurance, Interstate Cooperation, Judiciary Non-Civil, Juvenile Justice, and Technology and Infrastructure Innovation. This week, a House committee passed his bill (HB881) to empower the Prosecuting Attorneys Qualification Commission to self-govern.
To learn more about Representative Gullet, [CLICK HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XGRnd_FLTbzvX9Brzv_safE0khwp1dgYzzyX5OlhTeMvGTFdMEXsbLlOlpnvghw89QFBFoeeoP5PpEj81aB8kN-8YoC78TeEWNf5xMTRVxRAv3rwllUZ18qlXn_zJNHPIVEJraYUof5WRPZwK660ju3cgWjCcD6eXSJo9DQKyeZFae_U-oWA5h7Ss5GBXLancGDZZNoSanQ=&c=mZU7gHMOxRaB6RAxg3l-BDSES-hqb23BP81SN0_0dosgO5Vh338T1g==&ch=PgX6STqWV1X076nmQwIbn1qcMD9v8UPgyjaV3ucOzfaV_KHM7JwmDw==).

clean_body: January 25, 2024 | | | | == | Gold Dome Download January 25, 2024 Welcome to this year's first issue of the Gold Dome Download, your source for insights into legislative priorities at the State Capitol. As we step into 2024, our goal is to keep you informed about the major initiatives under consideration by state lawmakers - as well as the latest news in key areas like election integrity, education, public safety, and economic development. This year marks the second convening of the 157th Georgia General Assembly, which gaveled in on January 8th. We're just a few weeks in, and already lawmakers have brought forward a number of major bills that are making headlines. | | Governor's Priorities In his State of the State Address, Governor Kemp highlighted a number of his legislative priorities for 2024. View our summary below or click == to read his full remarks. Cutting Taxes Accelerating the existing state income tax cuts to bring even more savings to Georgia taxpayers (the 2024 rate will be lowered to 5.39%, saving taxpayers an estimated $1.1 billion this year alone) Infrastructure $1.8B allocated to improve Georgia's infrastructure Education Passing a school choice bill Increasing teacher salaries ($2,500) $104 million for school safety improvements Public Safety Increasing law enforcement salaries ($3,000) Supporting the Atlanta Public Safety Training Center Healthcare $1.6B for mental health programs * Continued investment to improve the private sector insurance exchange | | | Legislation to Watch Below you will find summaries of the top bills introduced in the legislature so far. Education Senate Bill 233 About: A bill to create a $6,000 school voucher program. Sponsor: Senator Greg Dolezal To read the bill, ==. Election Integrity Senate Bill 355 About: A bill to prohibit ranked-choice voting. Sponsor: Senator Randy Robertson To read the bill, ==. Senate Bill 358 About: A bill to remove the Secretary of State from the State Election Board and give the State Election Board power to investigate the Secretary of State. Sponsor: Senator Max Burns To read the bill, ==. Senate Resolution 443 About: Appointment of Rick Jeffares to the State Election Board. Sponsor: Senator John F. Kennedy To read the resolution, ==. Public Safety House Bill 30 About: A bill to provide for the definition of antisemitism. Sponsor: Representative John Carson To read the bill, ==. House Bill 881 About: A bill to amend the Prosecuting Attorneys Qualifications Commission. Sponsor: Representative Joseph Gullett To read the bill, ==. Senate Resolution 465 About: A bill to create a special Committee on Investigations to probe allegations of misconduct in Fulton County. Sponsor: Senator Greg Dolezal To read the resolution, ==. | | | Legislator Spotlight Here are some state lawmakers who have been in the headlines this week for their work on the legislation above! | Senator Max Burns (R-SD23) Senator Burns represents the 23rd Senate District, which covers several counties including Burke, Emanuel, Glascock, Jefferson, Jenkins, Johnson, McDuffie, Screven, Taliaferro and Warren. He serves as the Chairman of the Ethics Committee, Vice Chair of Higher Education, and is a member of the Children and Families and Agriculture and Consumer Affairs Committees. Senator Burns is the sponsor of numerous election bills, most notably SB358, the bill to remove the Secretary of State from the State Election Board - which passed a Senate committee this week. To learn more about Senator Burns, ==. | | Rep. Joseph Gullett (R-HD19) Representative Gullet serves the people of the 19th House District which encompasses part of Paulding County. He serves as the Vice Chair of Code Revision and as a member on Appropriations, Banks & Banking, Energy, Utilities & Telecommunications, Governmental Affairs, Insurance, Interstate Cooperation, Judiciary Non-Civil, Juvenile Justice, and Technology and Infrastructure Innovation. This week, a House committee passed his bill (HB881) to empower the Prosecuting Attorneys Qualification Commission to self-govern. To learn more about Representative Gullet, ==. | | | | Greater Georgia Updates | Faith and Freedom Legislative Luncheon Tuesday, January 23 Senator Loeffler was honored to == the annual Faith and Freedom Legislative Luncheon earlier this week, where she addressed a crowd of activists and lawmakers alike. # Join Us for a Weekend of Action with Nicole López for Congress!
---
| | |
---
| | Dear Friends and Supporters,
We are thrilled to invite you to our very first Weekend of Action in support of Nicole López's campaign for Congress in California's 42nd District!
This is a great opportunity for you to be a part of a grassroots movement dedicated to bringing real change for the working families of our community.
Here are the details you need to know:
Where: Salt Lake Park, 3401 E Florence Ave, Huntington Park, CAWhen: March 27 and March 28, 2024Time: 10 AM to 12 PMMeeting Point: The picnic tables near the Parks and Recreation Building
Nicole is not just a candidate; she's a community leader who always puts people first. This weekend is more than just door knocking - it's about connecting with our neighbors, talking about the issues that matter most to us, and laying the groundwork for a campaign that truly represents the needs and aspirations of our community.
Whether you're a seasoned campaigner or new to political action, your presence will make a huge difference. You'll be helping to introduce voters to Nicole, a candidate who genuinely cares and listens. Our grassroots approach means every conversation, every piece of campaign literature, and every interaction counts.
Let's come together this weekend to show CA-42 the strength of people-powered politics. We can't wait to see you there!

Peter Willis,

President Biden has sent $250 million worth of artillery shells and other
weapons to Israel in recent weeks. The United States has sent Netanyahu
billions of dollars. The U.S. government has watched as Israel’s war in
Gaza has killed over 25,000 people.

Now, Netanyahu admits as Israel continues to bomb the Palestinian people
that he’s restricting humanitarian aid in Gaza. This war is brutal in
every way possible, and there’s no excuse for continued U.S. support for
Israel’s horrific policies.

Bernie is going all out to oppose more funding for Israel’s war. We must
join him and say no more funding, no more weapons, and no more
restrictions on humanitarian aid.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14233?source=email-20240125&t=1011&akid=5246%2E5885482%2EtcPCcz ]Add your name: The Palestinian people are suffering while Congress
considers more aid for Netanyahu’s bombing campaigns. Stop the funding,
stop the weapons shipments, and press for the free flow of humanitarian
aid.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14233?source=email-20240125&t=1012&akid=5246%2E5885482%2EtcPCcz ]ADD YOUR NAME

Last week, Bernie forced a vote in the Senate on an investigation into
Israeli human rights abuses that could’ve halted U.S. funding to Israel.
But the Senate voted it down.

In his efforts, Bernie did not hold back on the reality of what the U.S.
is backing in Israel, saying, “The military campaign being waged by the
right-wing Netanyahu government has led to massive destruction and
widespread civilian harm. This has been, far and away, the most intensive
bombing campaign of the 21st century.”

Calls for a permanent ceasefire have grown since the start of this war,
with Peace champions like Barbara Lee, Rashida Tlaib, and Bernie Sanders
leading the way. But at the same time, President Biden made the unilateral
decision to send more ammunition to fuel Netanyahu’s war and Congress may
be on the verge of passing a spending bill that gives Israel another $10
billion. All to a murderous regime that now admits to restricting food,
water, and medical support the people of Gaza need.

We must ensure there’s a coalition in Congress ready to say NO to more war
funding for Israel.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/14233?source=email-20240125&t=1013&akid=5246%2E5885482%2EtcPCcz ]Will you add your name to stand with Bernie and urge Congress to oppose
all support for Israel’s brutal war and restrictions of aid in Gaza?

When we organize, we win.

name: Matthew Diemer
subject: I hate doing this
body:
| |
---
Peter, I hate doing this. I am loving every aspect of this campaign so far. I love talking about the issues. I love talking about my plans to move our community forward. I love getting out and meeting you and hearing what you want from our Government. But the one part of campaigning that I can’t stand is asking for money. I’m running to serve and support you, not the other way around. I’m tired of asking for money every day. It’s not a fun thing to do. When I get DC, the first thing I will seek to accomplish is campaign finance reform. Our current system is broken and allows for rampant corruption and gives special interests and the powerful a leg up. Sadly, raising money is a necessity in our current political system. In order to win, we need to be able to buy ad time, send mailers, and spread word about our campaign. And that takes money. This is a very tight race, and we can’t afford to fall behind on fundraising. We’re running against Rep. Max Miller, a former Trump aide who has DJT’s full support. We need strong fundraising to get ahead in this race. [If you could donate anything you can spare to our campaign, it would be greatly appreciated.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wDZWX9f_QGXYt8-x-WTsfwZ4tuJ-E3RbtDuUyIl3NBwwVxvVpXw22Hp4q1h6AFpu8EN-V2n8eWyCb2AbxoCDhTsGesheLui-Gv7QduXTUuWG61w2fgK2mEOTHr-RBddh_btIahPMDthuDG0EkVV3U3XkdcnfjtOTOEXHXOev90g07c99wcywt1Rsy9ztS8CNJiWM5Kjol4nO1XfUWeu6w_0Bm63m2i2JF0XEv6V1muj-N9PZjG8I7hCkneVRcdToSl8wfdLykIgoa_v6e2Y0IdGuXHJLM_IM0OmJk2m6znzw/43a/p0ZG1hXbRJ-Gt-oL7JXCcw/h0/3X1nk4r8Dx0ksWCrF6FQT9OS64UMjk9wDE7LY-sLqSc)

body:
Never forget where you came from

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zlmnnl6dlpp3lauc5k54e336f16ofjn54r42fbb0_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i62or4c1h2bs)
---
_**["Who IS Mike Johnson?"](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4qb6d43m8c4lt680floqbo5i2nada7m1siokg7g_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i62or4c1h2bs "“Who IS Mike Johnson?”")**_

That question has been asked and answered in the mainstream media constantly since I was elected Speaker of the House three months ago.

It probably won't surprise you that so much of what has been written and said isn't accurate at all. A lot of it has been openly hostile.

**[Washington and the press corps simply don't know what to do with a leader who is _unafraid to stand for faith, family, and freedom --and boldly profess his faith in Jesus Christ._](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1ks1q10vfabuc49lor60rnulsase1nrm49lvh7g_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i62or4c1h2bs "Washington and the press corps simply don’t know what to do with a leader who is unafraid to stand for faith, family, and freedom—and boldly profess his faith in Jesus Christ.")**

I wanted to take a moment to clarify a few things here because I expect you agree with me that these things are worth fighting for.

**[Indeed, I'm asking you to partner with me today to restore the principles that made America the most exceptional nation that's ever been.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9bfuh3m88v35gkd51lu50p93e4d6e2avnto99o8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i62or4c1h2bs "Indeed, I’m asking you to partner with me today to restore the principles that made America the most exceptional nation that’s ever been.")**

---
| | [BECOME A PARTNER - JOIN TEAM JOHNSON](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6dhbmdf6g704u0n34frii112pudmsoblt1ddt08_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i62or4c1h2bs)
---

_**Friend, this is my real story, without the media 's spin:**_

>From my earliest memories of childhood, my dad was my hero.

Because he served as a firefighter and assistant chief training officer, my highest aspiration was to one day become the chief of the fire department of our hometown of Shreveport, Louisiana.

But when I was just 12 years old, my dad was critically burned and permanently disabled in the line of duty. That fateful explosion changed the trajectory of all our lives.

Following our family tragedy, I had to grow up fast, help my parents take care of my three younger siblings and small family farm, and consider other ways to serve.

I became the first person in my family to go to college, and then to law school, and I dedicated my career in constitutional law to defending our fundamental freedoms in the courts.

My wife Kelly and I got married in 1999, just as I was beginning my law practice. Like so many other couples, as our family grew, we became increasingly concerned about the condition of our country and what our children's generation would inherit.

About nine years ago, after much prayer and deliberation, we decided to heed the call to run for public office and do our best to make a difference.

I was elected without opposition to the Louisiana Legislature, and a short time later, to an open seat in the U.S. Congress. Less than seven years after I arrived in Washington, on October 25, 2023, I was unanimously elected by my Republican colleagues to serve as the 56th Speaker of the House.

When I was growing up, I never dreamed any of this would be possible. But I am humbled and truly grateful for this opportunity.

_**[All I ever aspired to do is serve God and my country, in whatever capacity He called me.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zj7lc3hgslh1rdksjrpcdh67v1mqps8harq536ig_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i62or4c1h2bs "All I ever aspired to do is serve God and my country, in whatever capacity He called me.")**_

Friend, you and I both know that America is facing today one of the greatest collections of crises in our nation's history. The survival of our freedoms and the very future of our republic are hanging in the balance.

**[To SAVE America, we must keep and GROW the Republican Majority in the House. And to do that, I need partners and fellow warriors who are willing to fight by my side.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zet5mkd19auf12p13e4e5fqr9pg9g76me30lmro8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i62or4c1h2bs "To SAVE America, we must keep and GROW the Republican Majority in the House. And to do that, I need partners and fellow warriors who are willing to fight by my side.")**

**[Today, I want you to invite you to join my team and become one of those partners.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z144bh56majjk5blt25ae1nmk8qnl5r2b2i2ji8o_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i62or4c1h2bs "Today, I want you to invite you to join my team and become one of those partners.")**
**[JOIN TEAM JOHNSON>>](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrjgrcn806a7pegmcpiu4fm3it9b7o74cibose8o_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i62or4c1h2bs "JOIN TEAM JOHNSON")**
**Friend, we all know that this fall 's election will decide the fate of our republic. **And it has never been more important for us to stand together, defend truth and liberty, and restore the foundations of this extraordinary country God has given us.

It will take all of us to succeed. And I need YOUR help.

**[I humbly ask you to consider this invitation.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z67oj9d9s3iof6rvep6djt7ature9c1m60jtt7t0_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i62or4c1h2bs "I humbly ask you to consider this invitation.")**

Sincerely,

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zepdsmk2oh5ssiditv0l7nu2oua2k4h9nvbbhupg_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i62or4c1h2bs)
---
Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson

_**P.S.: I love this country and I 'm deeply grateful for the opportunity to serve. But Team Johnson can't save America from the radical Left and turn things around without the help of patriots like you. That's why I hope and pray that we can count on your support. [Would you consider joining Team Johnson today?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8qfldb7g531vb5dvopl5s5era4sguu43ih4ltko_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i62or4c1h2bs "Would you consider joining Team Johnson today?")**_

body:
This email is unlike anything I’ve ever sent you before.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z58ueesbsdorg2ir0imbun8l256ugpvf0mavhd68_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i66ob4c5h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj791jmkojfcbjkorrbdt1e2qjb91he6q3ctd6eur39d9hejrq0t1lkgr32t5nmeruasblmvb38ddgegqbectls9g64ob0chh6aop5e5qrflhnmeonactheni38cthqeot2sehe8iv0)

This email is unlike anything I've ever sent you before.

No, this isn't about a campaign or an election.

I'm sending you an urgent message about an organization I'm personally supporting, The Atlas Society.

Their CEO, Jennifer Grossman, has been my friend for thirty years -- we got our start in cable news together in the mid-1990s, and she later hired my firm to do polling when she worked at Dole Food Company. Through ups and downs, we've remained friends.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zufnpn9qacdtko568henjml2imgotbgcei1ueg58_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i66ob4c5h2bs)

Today, she's the CEO of The Atlas Society, a non-profit organization whose mission is to spread Ayn Rand's message of capitalism, personal responsibility, reason, and entrepreneurship to young people. **[I promised Jennifer I would help her raise $25,000 to support the mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $500, $1,000, or ANY amount >>>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7isnumdd5r1l2t568bb2q85mge59d25g20jpgm8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i66ob4c5h2bs)**

Why is The Atlas Society's mission so important?

If my career in polling and serving as President Trump's 2016 Campaign Manager taught me anything, it's this: Americans are _**desperate**_ to hear the unfiltered truth.

**This is why we need more young people to hear The Atlas Society 's message. Here is what Jennifer and her organization are fighting for:**

* Free market capitalism
* Respect for achievement and success
* Free speech
* The future of young people and our great country

Our culture is pushing a twisted message of victimization, envy, woke nonsense, socialism, class warfare, and hatred for our country and founding principles.

Young people need an alternative.

The Atlas Society spreads Ayn Rand's message to millions of young people via social media, video content, graphic novels, conferences, and so much more.

I promised Jennifer I would help her raise $25,000 for The Atlas Society, which is why I am reaching out to you. Please consider making a donation by using one of the links I've copied below:
