[Donate $100](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zo82n0mpspqlbepnkddfhb74l1sqjb8mub6tv0io_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i66ob4c5h2bs)
[Donate $250](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6uh3b3vupm3a7eh2v0k888q9283fovs417rpcm8_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i66ob4c5h2bs)
[Donate $500](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlcthsm6ahc1g36c08a8o9p3dipo8nojbq5s4tj0_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i66ob4c5h2bs)
[Donate $1,000](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zroia4g9lbiif3he6ct79sb995joc009s4g5n4oo_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i66ob4c5h2bs)
[Donate ANY Amount](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5e3h0btgptab60cp1vmnunt0kjel66ec758sbqo_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i66ob4c5h2bs)

You may be surprised, but when young people hear Ayn Rand's message of entrepreneurship, refusing to be a victim and personal achievement, they are inspired and want to learn more.

Yes, politics are important. But politics are downstream from culture. And culture is downstream from philosophy. The Atlas Society is on the frontlines of fighting in the philosophical culture war, which may determine the fate of the country's future.

We CANNOT give up the culture or give up young people.

This is more important than a campaign or a single election.

You and I must invest in reaching young people with this message.

Please don't wait to take action.

My goal is to raise this $25,000 ASAP within a 48-hour period. Can I count on you to make a donation?

[Here is the link to donate more one time.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgmt59p137tco7t5h6kevhn4b225m94jqghho0d0_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9i66ob4c5h2bs)

Kellyanne Conway, Former Senior Counselor to President Trump

On Monday, I joined my opponents on stage in Los Angeles for the first of three planned debates happening in this race. It was spirited, informative, and gave Californians a chance to see how each of us would lead if elected to the job.
One of the challenges of any debate is that you have to fit answers to big, complex questions into short frames of time. So today, I want to go "beyond the 60 second answer" and tell you about a topic I spoke about frequently during the debate: **standing up to a Congress that caters to big corporations, and creating an economy that works for everyone. Here 's a clip from Monday night:**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f2b8e0be-4920-4c3f-bbe8-aaedae00d1d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It's clear we have a real problem with wealth inequality. Between 2019 and 2022, the top 10% of wage earners saw their incomes increase by [22%](https://substack.com/redirect/5ae6a290-27aa-4b52-bd6b-860241ebad34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). By comparison, middle-income earners saw a 5% increase over the same time period. **And rising, record-breaking corporate profits have accounted for[*over half*](https://substack.com/redirect/a6efbe1f-3a1c-46f1-9bac-eaedec272edb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the higher prices people are paying across industries.**
To close the gap, we have to put more money in people's pockets and lower the costs that drain families. We should raise the minimum wage at the federal level, with a higher minimum for California. And Congress should go beyond that and actually invest in things families need to thrive, like:
* **Medicare for All:** This is the most efficient way to get the highest quality healthcare to all Americans.
* **Affordable Housing:** Washington hasn't made a serious investment in housing since the GI Bill. We've run our housing policy to benefit Wall Street, and now we're dealing with the consequences. We have to stop blaming local governments and instead help them create more affordable housing.
* **Affordable Child Care:** I'll keep fighting for legislation that caps child care costs at 7% of a family's income.
* **Free Community College:** California is a leader here, and we should expand tuition-free community college nationwide.

The ideas I just listed are generally popular with voters. But we haven't made progress on these things because we have a Congress that is deeply dependent on corporate cash.**Business interests alone spent $3.5 billion on federal political contributions during the 2022 election cycle.**
**It 's no wonder, efforts to crack down on monopolies, prevent price-gouging, or hold corporations accountable often fall flat. That lack of accountability allows prices to rise and wages to stagnate.**
In order to finally get sh*t done in Washington, we should ban corporate PAC and federal lobbyist money. I'm the only person in this race who has said that, and the only one to also turn away money from CEOs at Big Banks, Big Oil, and Big Pharma.
Taking our fight to the U.S. Senate will only be possible with the support of real people. [If you'd like to help us amplify debate clips like the one you just watched, please consider chipping in to our campaign.](https://substack.com/redirect/8c648306-8b35-4b06-aefc-2ed2c159d391?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Onward!
Katie Porter

Peter,
Last week, we wrote to you about _The Baltimore Sun’s_ acquisition by the Sinclair Broadcast Group, the right-wing media empire that’s been gobbling up local media outlets for the last decade.
_The Sun,_ which won a Pulitzer Prize in 2020 for its high-quality local reporting, is now under the control of David D. Smith — the chairman of Sinclair and a close ally of Donald Trump.
But before we continue to explain why their relationship matters, **[can you pitch in $5 or anything that makes sense to you so we can continue to be the good information bulwark against right-wing media empires like Sinclair?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77717117/451290923/-927058160?refcode=em20240125&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzkyZjU5MjUtYTFiYi1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=rSZk4W6viYcQZUiDJjEcxBjrx2_z_jSpw4oaxv0-w8E=)**
If you’re curious to know how a Sinclair-owned _Baltimore Sun_ would cover Donald Trump, just take a look at what Smith promised Trump about Sinclair during the 2016 election:
**_"We are here to deliver your message."_** _— David D. Smith as quoted in The Guardian in 2018._
**Smith wasn't joking, Peter.** For the last decade, Sinclair's rise has been a part of a long-term plan to replace local news with mass-produced right-wing propaganda.
Part of Smith's plan even included meeting with Trump in the White House to pitch him on new programs.
Sinclair is now **_the second largest owner_** of local television stations across the country, and its acquisition of _The Baltimore Sun_ is another step in its campaign to wipe out local newsrooms and replace them with right-wing misinformation machines.
**COURIER was founded to be the good information antidote to the right-wing disinformation campaigns being pushed by Sinclair and others.** Our mission is to provide the communities we serve with impactful, local news about the real issues that matter to them.

Fellow American,

My name is Ben Toma. I am running to represent Arizona’s 8th Congressional District in Congress.

My story starts not here... but in Romania as a youth before **my family fled Communism to pursue a better, free life in America.**

**My father was discriminated against for being a Christian** , and when it became clear he was being targeted to be “disappeared” by the communist state. The secret police even took up residence in our home.

My parents knew it was time to get out. They fled in the middle of the night, leaving us in the care of our grandparents. They sought asylum everywhere they could, and by the Grace of God they received asylum in the United States.

It was more than two years before me and my siblings were allowed to leave Romania and join our parents in America.

_**I’ll never forget that first taste of freedom.**_ That realization that we didn’t have to live in fear anymore.

This country has given me so much. Opportunities, success, a beautiful family and so much more. When I noticed changes going on in our state – calls for more government, more spending, higher taxes – I knew I had to get in the fight to stop it.

**Today, I’m the Speaker of the Arizona House of Representatives.**

I learned quickly that if you believe in something, work hard for it, and you can make it happen – even against all odds.

**That’s the attitude I took when _I passed Arizona’s historic “flat tax” legislation_ which remains the largest tax cut in Arizona history!**

ACROSS THE COMMONWEALTH
VOTE TODAY! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/Make%20A%20Plan%20To%20Vote.png]
You can vote for November's elections NOW! Vote at your Registrar's office during business hours. Saturday early voting is available October 28th and November 4th. Learn More [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
Find your local Registrar's office here: https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/VWCC.jpeg] 15 years of the Community College Access Program at VWCC
Learn More [https://www.wdbj7.com/2023/09/26/virginia-western-celebrates-15th-anniversary-ccap-program/] CCAP is a successful public/private partnership that pays the cost of tuition for three years at Virginia Western Community College if a qualified student does not have sufficient financial aid to pay tuition costs.
This program has helped over 4,200 students achieve higher education!
CANDIDATE SPOTLIGHT
https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89
Donate Here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/karenforvirginia] Karen Jenkins is a life-long resident of the City of Suffolk. Throughout her lifetime she has passionately advocated for others and currently serves on the Suffolk School Board with a proven track record and history of accomplishments. She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.
She is a champion for education, public safety and mental health. As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. At the state level, she will be positioned to write and sponsor bills and laws to benefit the schools and communities in the 89th District and throughout the commonwealth.
LOCAL CANDIDATE EVENTS
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/lily%20canvass.png]
Canvass for Lily Franklin!
On Sundays, join Team Lily at the South County Library Parking Lot from 12 - 12:30 pm for a Roanoke canvassing event!

Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game - Oct. 1 Henrietta Lacks Statue Unveiling - Oct. 4
Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. A dignified sculpture will commemorate the ongoing and long unrecognized contributions of Roanoke native Henrietta Lacks, who unknowingly provided the world with the HeLa cell, fueling decades of life-saving and life changing research.
Physicians, nurses and administrators will suit up for each hospital during the nine-inning contest. Proceeds will benefit the American Heart Association. Unveiling is October 4th at 11 am at Henrietta Lacks Plaza.
Admission is $5 at the gate, kids under 10 free. Gates open at 1pm and the game starts at 2pm. 410 3rd St SW, Roanoke, VA 24011

Hi teammate — It’s Graham Small here, Finance Director for Team Ehasz. **I couldn’t wait to share these numbers with you:**
* Last quarter, we marked _our largest fundraising haul_ since Ashley launched her campaign to unseat Brian Fitzpatrick.
* _Nearly _86%_ of donations for the quarter were $100 or less_ — a testament to the grassroots momentum we have thanks to supporters like you.
* Our average grassroots donation is $17.44 (because we don't accept a single penny from corporate PACs).

Peter — When I was 21 years old, I had an abortion. **That abortion saved my life.** I was married when I found out I was pregnant. I wanted to start a family. One devastating diagnosis from my doctor later, and all my plans had to change. I had an aortic aneurysm that was at risk of rupturing. If it did, I would die. I also couldn't have it treated without first having an abortion. Peter, I was lucky. My choice to have an abortion was protected by _Roe v. Wade_. Since it was overturned and Tennessee’s disastrous abortion ban took effect, the decision my doctors and I made is one that a woman in Tennessee _can’t_ make today. The radical GOP won’t allow it. Women in Tennessee — and across this country in Republican-controlled states — are terrified of what might happen if they have an ectopic pregnancy, a fatal fetal abnormality, a miscarriage that doesn’t resolve without medical care, or any other of the devastating diagnoses that can happen in pregnancy. Abortion care is a matter of life and death. 51 years ago this week, the _Roe v. Wade_ decision guaranteed women our basic human right of bodily autonomy — but as we’ve seen, it wasn’t enough. clean_body: This is my abortion story. | Peter — When I was 21 years old, I had an abortion. That abortion saved my life. I was married when I found out I was pregnant. I wanted to start a family. One devastating diagnosis from my doctor later, and all my plans had to change. I had an aortic aneurysm that was at risk of rupturing. If it did, I would die. I also couldn't have it treated without first having an abortion. Peter, I was lucky. My choice to have an abortion was protected by Roe v. Wade. Since it was overturned and Tennessee’s disastrous abortion ban took effect, the decision my doctors and I made is one that a woman in Tennessee can’t make today. The radical GOP won’t allow it. Women in Tennessee — and across this country in Republican-controlled states — are terrified of what might happen if they have an ectopic pregnancy, a fatal fetal abnormality, a miscarriage that doesn’t resolve without medical care, or any other of the devastating diagnoses that can happen in pregnancy. Abortion care is a matter of life and death. 51 years ago this week, the Roe v. Wade decision guaranteed women our basic human right of bodily autonomy — but as we’ve seen, it wasn’t enough. We need to enshrine the right to reproductive health care in our federal laws. As your next Senator, I’ll fight like hell to do exactly that. = | = = = = Yours in solidarity, Gloria Johnson = | Gloria Johnson is running for the U.S. Senate because Tennesseans deserve leaders who care. For too long, elected officials like Marsha Blackburn have done absolutely nothing to make Tennesseans’ lives better. The only interests they’ve cared about are special interests. The only people they’ve championed are their donors. Gloria will advocate for real solutions to protect our communities from gun violence, make health care more affordable and accessible for all of us, secure access to the ballot box, and defend reproductive rights. | = = Follow along: | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Gloria for Tennessee Contributions or gifts to Gloria for Tennessee are not tax deductible. Friend,

When I stepped off stage in New Hampshire, here is the message I shared...

You've all heard the chatter among the political class. They're falling all over themselves saying this race is over.

Well, I have news for all of them. New Hampshire is first in the nation. **_It 's not last in the nation._**

**This race is far from over.** There are dozens of states left to go. And the next one is my sweet state of South Carolina!

At one point in this campaign, there were 14 of us running, and we were at two percent in the polls. Well, I'm a fighter. Now, we're the last one standing next to Donald Trump, and today we got close to half of the vote. We still have a ways to go, but we keep moving up.

For a lot of people, politics is way too personal. It's not personal for me.

I decided to run because I'm worried about the future of our country, and because it's time to put the negativity and chaos behind us.

We have an economy that is crushing middle-class Americans. We have a border that is totally open and dangerous, creating a disaster in our country. We have schools that are failing too many of our children. And we have a world on fire, with war in Europe and the Middle East, and a huge and growing threat from China.

And then you look at Washington. We have a Congress that fights about everything and accomplishes nothing. And we have Joe Biden in the White House, making one bad decision after another, when he's making any decisions at all.

Our country's in a real mess. _And the question is, who 's going to fix it?_

With Donald Trump, Republicans have lost almost every competitive election. We lost the Senate. We lost the House. We lost the White House. We lost in 2018, in 2020 and in 2022.

The worst kept secret in politics is how badly the Democrats want to run against Trump. They know Trump is the only Republican in the country who Biden can defeat.

You can't fix the mess if you don't win the election. A Trump nomination is a Biden win and a Kamala Harris presidency.

**I defeat Biden handily.**

With Donald Trump, you have one bout of chaos after another. This court case, that controversy, this tweet, that senior moment. You can't fix Joe Biden's chaos with Republican chaos.

The other day, Donald Trump accused me of not providing security at the Capitol on January 6th.

I've long called for mental competency tests for politicians over the age of 75. Trump claims he'd do better than me on one of those tests. Maybe he would, and maybe he wouldn't.

But if he thinks that, then he should have no problem standing on a debate stage with me!

Most Americans do not want a rematch between Biden and Trump. The first party to retire its 80-year-old candidate is going to win this election. I say it should be the Republicans!

**So our fight is not over, because we have a country to save.** | [JOIN OUR MOVEMENT](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=3f338ab9cc85464ab5746b5f878117f8&_e=NdofDMtrwL4WBTNDrdustb4ylrns82kebxHe9CFMRbRz61YYR418VRXCIfH4tzGSh5CsJIV9k4Bjp_kOjwXseSwRqzq--2lYmX_mTwYzRF4OvZe5DKtlarbgaz-shs2yx61uOOthkuYQ5UbNAjNHI47BfqEx8F8FT_Z9kmxU45UJmdKtHv6rQRPw0M4Ed_iYx4F5k0Mm1fR3lHG0rDd4ivGh7Iqh3U3QqitClmwQI5nf88NCMpqp_abcBdx-YAfEOgJcfL2ZWBDmKobRZq8dYj2HiPR34tXXckZVTtvkTRo4o3T5I9jAb2DOE0JiJ-olQbZalWJoCEO-ltRoG0UNBjJAWEhpZ9YpAqq4oIcu__g%3D)
---

In the next two months, millions of voters in over 20 states will have their say. We should honor them and allow them to vote. And guess what, in the next two months, Joe Biden isn't going to get any younger or any better. We'll have all the time we need to beat Biden.

When we get to South Carolina, Donald Trump is going to have a harder time falsely attacking me. The great people of South Carolina know I cut their taxes. They know I signed the toughest immigration bill in the country. They know we passed voter ID, and tort reform, and ethics reform, and they know we moved 35,000 people from welfare to work.

Every time I've run for office in South Carolina, I've beaten the political establishment. They're lined up against me again. That's no surprise. But South Carolina voters don't want a coronation. They want an election. And we're going to give them one.

Because we're just getting started.

| | **For Immediate Release:** January 25, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**The Fraternal Order Of Police Endorses Dave Min**
_Law Enforcement Trusts Sen. Dave Min_
**IRVINE, CA** — Today, the Fraternal Order of Police is announcing their endorsement of Dave Min for California’s 47th Congressional District. FOP is the fourth public safety organization to support Min, following endorsements from the Association for Los Angeles Deputy Sheriffs (ALADS), Los Angeles Police Protective League (LAPPL), and Police Officers Research Association of California (PORAC), the state’s largest police association. Dave Min is trusted not only by law enforcement, but also teachers, school employees, labor, gun prevention advocates.

**“Dave Min is public safety’s choice for CA-47,”** said Roger Hilton, President of the California Fraternal Order of Police.**“Sen. Min has always ensured that law enforcement and first responders have the tools they need to keep Southern California’s families safe and secure. We know he’ll be our advocate in DC, and we look forward to working with him.”**

The California FOP represents over 20,000 law enforcement officers. Founded in 1915, the FOP seeks to increase the efficiency of the law enforcement profession and thus more firmly to establish the confidence of the public in the service dedicated to the protection of life and property. Backed by the FOP and PORAC, Dave Min is now endorsed by each of Orange County’s law enforcement departments. Public safety officers trust Dave Min to continue the work he’s done in the State Senate to keep our families safe and our communities secure.

This endorsement builds on Senator Min’s incredible momentum in his campaign to keep this seat Blue. Last week, [Min received the coveted endorsement of the Los Angeles Times](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=64b25fc8f9&e=7017cc100e). He is also endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, as well as the California Democratic Party, Service Employees International Union (SEIU), the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, California Environmental Voters, and over 150 local, state, and federal officials. Min is the unanimous choice of organized labor in this race, as he is the only candidate to receive support from national, statewide, and local unions, and he is the only candidate endorsed in this race by the California Labor Federation or the AFL-CIO. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=0c833a613b&e=7017cc100e). ###

_California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

clean_body: Voting starts in 11 days, and we need to get the word out about this endorsement immediately. Mike Feuer for Congress | BIG NEWS: Giffords, the gun violence prevention organization founded by former Congresswoman Gabrielle Giffords, just endorsed our campaign for Congress! = = This endorsement is particularly meaningful for me. I’ve made preventing gun violence a priority throughout my career. Our country’s gun violence crisis is an outrage. But we aren’t helpless. We can do something about it. I’ve been honored to work with former Congresswoman Gabrielle Giffords and her extraordinary organization for many years. She understands that saving lives from gun violence can’t wait. We agree that gun violence is not just one on a list of issues but an urgent public health and safety crisis. I’ve written first-in-the-nation gun safety legislation, worked to disarm domestic abusers, co-founded the nation’s first prosecutors coalition to combat gun violence, and much more. I won’t rest until we pass lifesaving legislation in Washington to tackle our nation’s gun violence emergency. body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=36971%2E3422442%2ESkW52T)
**California’s U.S. Senate primary is 40 days away**
**The challenge: This competitive race features more than two dozen candidates, one of which has stockpiled more money than any other Democrat in the country. Another is a celebrity Republican with high name ID. And our campaign has the very expensive task of reaching voters in the country’s most populous state— _California’s population is equal to the population of 21 other states combined._**
**The stakes:** We’ll never fear-monger you. Barring something truly unexpected, California will be represented by a Democrat in the US Senate. But there are distinct differences between Katie and the other Democrats in this race, and Californians have a once in a generation chance to send someone other than a career politician to Washington. A consumer protection advocate and single mom, Katie is the only candidate in this race who has never taken a dime from corporate PACs, and will truly stand up to the corporate interests that run Washington.
**The plan:** Polls show Katie at risk of losing, so we need to reach millions of voters before our March 5th primary. The most efficient way to do that is through TV and digital ads. If we don’t ramp up soon, we risk our opponents drowning us out.

Fellow Conservative,

**As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle.** Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

My name is Tim Sheehy, Republican candidate for U.S. Senate from Montana. You probably don't know me, or if you do, likely from emails like this one. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority.

**[I'm reaching out today to make the case that I'm worth your personal endorsement](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=c37ea535a789452798641095d18fb4b7&_e=-r1q-LGbDGX4zXPy-xH552Z4-dc7KGTGZU9lEoYiei7shRuSH1FszIPoWCaArgH5kd4s_z6Kk3d-rFqdMW71zNM8OPPwvi_CwDweiV_N2RNR9MgzJyL-MCjmwQhag5oXYBPdaQVG_iWyVl_eITJ2LfiIjWKICxdLYBlbxFAfmVsK0HxFawE5oacVyQjLJf4h08Vo6keHrZRy8Vx0oD8QbeZ6_1mfILIsFzXlIIeWXmzR9Ir2WXiqGMhHY9ozyUC44xvHq3jDLyXMv6jeuXYk1cOg7HaRUBtoMDvUQVNqoIooSPIXmxyNtolLmH70RtlZ-iFe1B0Qw1UNvV5rOgEbac3puuTVT1ATzEFp5HpoqkaQRBcNcuVcXKQ7tSE2uPuT3NSlDc0hgnZhv6JxPTIfv7usZqp-SQ-uCuN6Sk9PmQw%3D)**.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=c37ea535a789452798641095d18fb4b7&_e=-r1q-LGbDGX4zXPy-xH552Z4-dc7KGTGZU9lEoYiei7shRuSH1FszIPoWCaArgH5kd4s_z6Kk3d-rFqdMW71zNM8OPPwvi_CwDweiV_N2RNR9MgzJyL-MCjmwQhag5oXYBPdaQVG_iWyVl_eITJ2LfiIjWKICxdLYBlbxFAfmVsK0HxFawE5oacVyQjLJf4h08Vo6keHrZRy8Vx0oD8QbeZ6_1mfILIsFzXlIIeWXmzR9Ir2WXiqGMhHY9ozyUC44xvHq3jDLyXMv6jeuXYk1fkyPgwbUHaGUZqAczUZmEXFlwevDS7uWMgC933gC8sOmiL6_B5NulBYdgsXziRjUdEDTNmon5mP9zZfxyneZ4kbHE-9T4gqPbOxCWyBOtwstEJBWOrfBpz4JP2HetUYLvQxv0cn5G9LevnV50zXWRA%3D)
In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [**many veterans like me**] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. _**Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.**_ I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.

**[Today, I’m reaching out to ask you to personally endorse my campaign to become the next U.S. Senator from Montana.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=c37ea535a789452798641095d18fb4b7&_e=-r1q-LGbDGX4zXPy-xH552Z4-dc7KGTGZU9lEoYiei7shRuSH1FszIPoWCaArgH5kd4s_z6Kk3d-rFqdMW71zNM8OPPwvi_CwDweiV_N2RNR9MgzJyL-MCjmwQhag5oXYBPdaQVG_iWyVl_eITJ2LfiIjWKICxdLYBlbxFAfmVsK0HxFawE5oacVyQjLJf4h08Vo6keHrZRy8Vx0oD8QbeZ6_1mfILIsFzXlIIeWXmzR9Ir2WXiqGMhHY9ozyUC44xvHq3jDLyXMv6jeuXYk1bGlnHJooOusClLldldPibMmFv-Cjastg1r0ZABTKZEus0OPu6b0j_ZSjPTWcGADh5Cn7cArpkZTXKJxUpAb6KR1P0pWsqJmtaRWXWr6bQ4SvOTuMUqMk7SKqChY7IGlgi9qajb9ZuMdoP75DaGxI9k%3D)**

_**Chuck Schumer and Washington Democrats know that I pose a direct threat to their chances of holding on to power, and they'll do anything to stop me from winning this race - and spend $100M plus in the process. **_

Fellow Conservative, I am under no illusions that you will support my campaign the first time you hear from me. But my life experiences have taught me that **anything worth having requires working tirelessly, breaking down walls, and moving mountains to get it.**

**I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read.**

In the Navy, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy. This rings especially true for the individuals who have earned the honor of serving in the elite task force that is the Navy SEALs, a group of highly trained combat warriors – a brotherhood – in which I earned a spot following my graduation from the United States Naval Academy at Annapolis.

Team, this is a message from Elissa Slotkin’s campaign HQ in Michigan. With just 10 months to go before the election, Donald Trump is leading Joe Biden by 8 points in the state of Michigan, according to a new poll from The Detroit News and WDIV-TV. Take a look: Joe Biden: 39%
Donald Trump: 47% Polls this far out from the election should, of course, be taken with a healthy grain of salt. They are a snapshot in time. But at this point, we’ve seen a few public polls released on the presidential race here in Michigan, and there are some big takeaways:
1. The road to the White House — and ultimately, control of the Senate — WILL run through Michigan. As Michigan goes, so goes the nation.

2. It’s going to be close. That’s just a fact about presidential elections in Michigan. In 2016, Donald Trump won the state by 10,704 votes and then in 2020, Joe Biden won by 154,188 (less than 3%).

I mean who wants to elect somebody who basically says, 'I'm just the pass-through, you will get nothing from me..."

# Join the Movement for Change!
**I hope this email finds you well and motivated to make a positive impact in our community.**
**Today, I am reaching out to share an exciting opportunity for you to be a part of a movement that is focused on creating real change.**
**Our mission is clear - to stand up against the misguided policies proposed by MAGA GOP leaders like Bill Huizenga and Pete Hoekstra.**
|
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | |
## What we’re up against

**It's time to take a stand and ensure that the voices of hardworking individuals like yourself are heard. Sign our petition to get on the August Ballot and be a catalyst for change. Your support, whether big or small, will play a crucial role in helping us achieve the transformation our community deserves.**
**The MAGA GOP agenda includes plans to tax lower income workers, provide tax breaks for the ultra-wealthy, and keep seniors working longer for their hard earned Social Security benefits.**
**Also perhaps most alarmingly, they are seeking to infringe upon the reproductive rights and body autonomy of all women. This is unacceptable. Now, more than ever, we need your support to push back against these harmful policies.**
---
|

|
---

| | | | | | | | |

## What you can do

**Join us in making a difference. Sign our petition to get on the August’s primary ballot, and together, we can stand against injustice, fight for economic fairness, and protect the rights we hold dear.**
**Your involvement is the key to the change we need.**
**Thank you for your time and consideration. Together, we can build a better future for all.**
---
|
---
**Can you help us make a greater impact by contributing $10, $20, or $40 monthly? Your support is crucial, and acting now will ensure we reach more people and make a difference faster. Join us in our mission today!**

| Donald Trump is the greatest threat to democracy — and I’m not just talking about here in the United States.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=5205%2E5257348%2E6BMmsI)
Derek — At the California Senate debate on Monday, Republican Steve Garvey claimed that our country was safer and more secure under President Donald Trump than under President Joe Biden.
**I couldn’t disagree more. Donald Trump is the greatest threat to democracy — and I’m not just talking about here in the United States.**
Worldwide, democratic countries are terrified of the prospect of a second Trump presidency.
_And they should be._
During his time in the White House, Trump cozied up to Vladimir Putin and the Kremlin. He exchanged love letters with the dictator of North Korea, and has a warmer relationship with Kim Jong-un than the Canadian Prime Minister. He even threatened to abandon our NATO allies if there was an attack in Europe.
**And he extorted Ukraine’s president Volodymyr Zelenskyy to open an investigation into President Biden — by withholding military aid for their war against Russia. That led to his first impeachment — where I served as lead impeachment manager in the Senate chamber.**
While President Biden has worked to restore our country’s standing with our allies, Trump would be like a bull in a china shop on the global stage — much to the delight of autocratic leaders worldwide.
Derek, I have stood up against authoritarianism and in support of democracy for my entire career. From my chairmanship of the House Intelligence Committee to leading Trump’s impeachment, to serving on the January 6 Select Committee, **I have always put my oath of office and the Constitution first.**
That’s what this campaign is about — protecting our democracy and building an economy that works for everyone. Bringing truth to light and ensuring autocratic leaders who claim they alone can fix our problems never serve as president.
**[If you’re with me, today is an important day to show your support. We are less than 6 weeks away from this primary election, and early voting begins even sooner. If you can spare $10 or any amount, I promise you it will make a difference. body:
A Note From Chrissy

As I write this, it's 19 degrees in my snowy backyard, and I hope you and your family are staying safe and warm!

In the life of a representative, you don't get much time to look back at the end of the year – at all of the achievements, and the things you could have done better. Duty and the next day always ends up calling, and now, I'm headed full speed into this critical election year. But, I wanted to take a moment to share with you some of the most important things that happened this January.

https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/houlahan-digital?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk941-ot-text

More Paid Leave for More People: A Framework for Paid Family Leave

After spending most of 2023 meeting with employers, insurers, academics, and policymakers, I'm proud to announce that the House Bipartisan Paid Family Leave Working Group, that I co-founded and co-chair with Rep. Stephanie Bice (R-OK), released a framework outlining our group's consensus for paid family leave options.

The document presents four initial pillars of possible legislative policy: a public-private partnership, coordination and harmonization of paid benefits across states, small employer pooling, and improvements to paid leave tax credits for small businesses and working families. I’ve long said that a new parent shouldn’t have to choose between putting food on the table and spending time with a newborn. I'm looking forward to working with our partners in the U.S. Senate to get improvements to our paid leave system across the finish line!

We Have 3 Opponents!

I know that this fight won't be easy – but I want to reaffirm that I am in it for the long haul. No matter who the GOP throws in this race, I am entirely confident of the commitment of this team, our vision for Pennsylvania, and of the incredible progress we've made together. The work we've done speaks for itself, and I have no doubt that, in conjunction with our hard work, the voters of our district will see that.

https://houlahan.house.gov/news/documentsingle.aspx?DocumentID=3740&refcode=jtk941-ot-text

The State of the Sixth Town Hall at The Colonial Theater

Every year, I look forward to the annual tradition of my State of the Sixth Town Hall – and this year was no different. On Jan. 16, more than 100 community members braved the snow and freezing cold temperatures to come to Phoenixville to hear updates on my work on behalf of Chester and Berks Counties, to offer feedback to me, and for me to answer questions from the audience. Among the topics of discussion were recent and upcoming legislation and pressing local, national, and international issues. I value every opportunity I have to speak directly with my constituents, and I am so happy with the result of this year's State of the Sixth.

https://houlahan.house.gov/news/documentsingle.aspx?DocumentID=3740&refcode=jtk941-ot-text

The Middle East

I, along with five of my colleagues with national security backgrounds, sent a letter to President Biden urging him to “use all our leverage to achieve an immediate and significant shift of military strategy and tactics in Gaza.” We wrote that “the mounting civilian death toll and humanitarian crisis are unacceptable and not in line with American interests...We know from personal and often painful experience that you can’t destroy a terror ideology with military force alone. And it can, in fact, make it worse.” I will continue to push for a resolution to this war which aligns with the values of democracies worldwide.

https://houlahan.house.gov/news/documentsingle.aspx?DocumentID=3740&refcode=jtk941-ot-text

I know the months ahead won't be easy but it’s comforting to know that we’re in this together. Thank you for being on my team.

There's work to be done,

Chrissy

clean_body: A Note From Chrissy As I write this, it's 19 degrees in my snowy backyard, and I hope you and your family are staying safe and warm! In the life of a representative, you don't get much time to look back at the end of the year – at all of the achievements, and the things you could have done better. Duty and the next day always ends up calling, and now, I'm headed full speed into this critical election year. But, I wanted to take a moment to share with you some of the most important things that happened this January. More Paid Leave for More People: A Framework for Paid Family Leave After spending most of 2023 meeting with employers, insurers, academics, and policymakers, I'm proud to announce that the House Bipartisan Paid Family Leave Working Group, that I co-founded and co-chair with Rep. Stephanie Bice (R-OK), released a framework outlining our group's consensus for paid family leave options. The document presents four initial pillars of possible legislative policy: a public-private partnership, coordination and harmonization of paid benefits across states, small employer pooling, and improvements to paid leave tax credits for small businesses and working families. I’ve long said that a new parent shouldn’t have to choose between putting food on the table and spending time with a newborn. I'm looking forward to working with our partners in the U.S. Senate to get improvements to our paid leave system across the finish line! We Have 3 Opponents! I know that this fight won't be easy – but I want to reaffirm that I am in it for the long haul. No matter who the GOP throws in this race, I am entirely confident of the commitment of this team, our vision for Pennsylvania, and of the incredible progress we've made together. The work we've done speaks for itself, and I have no doubt that, in conjunction with our hard work, the voters of our district will see that. The State of the Sixth Town Hall at The Colonial Theater Every year, I look forward to the annual tradition of my State of the Sixth Town Hall – and this year was no different. On Jan. 16, more than 100 community members braved the snow and freezing cold temperatures to come to Phoenixville to hear updates on my work on behalf of Chester and Berks Counties, to offer feedback to me, and for me to answer questions from the audience. Among the topics of discussion were recent and upcoming legislation and pressing local, national, and international issues. I value every opportunity I have to speak directly with my constituents, and I am so happy with the result of this year's State of the Sixth. The Middle East I, along with five of my colleagues with national security backgrounds, sent a letter to President Biden urging him to “use all our leverage to achieve an immediate and significant shift of military strategy and tactics in Gaza.” We wrote that “the mounting civilian death toll and humanitarian crisis are unacceptable and not in line with American interests...We know from personal and often painful experience that you can’t destroy a terror ideology with military force alone. And it can, in fact, make it worse.” I will continue to push for a resolution to this war which aligns with the values of democracies worldwide. I know the months ahead won't be easy but it’s comforting to know that we’re in this together. Thank you for being on my team. There's work to be done, Chrissy

| | Have you been following what's happening in Texas, Peter?

Joe Biden has abandoned his basic Constitutional duty to enforce our immigration laws and protect Texas from the invasion at its southern border...

... so Texas Gov. Greg Abbott is claiming the state's Constitutional right in Article I, § 10, Clause 3 to self-defense.

What does that mean? _**Texas is giving state National Guard and other personnel the power to defy federal authorities and secure the border themselves ... and as of this morning a dozen other states are standing with them. **_

_**The Democrats and the Media may be having a meltdown ... but I want you to know that I am 100% standing with Texas!**_

I talk a lot about the need for bold and urgent leadership. Governor Abbott is showing what's possible when Republicans actually stand up, stick our necks out, and LEAD!

Look - it's undeniable that Joe Biden is violating his oath to keep our country safe. Millions of illegal immigrants, many of them suspected terrorists and drug traffickers, have entered our country under his watch.

_**If Joe Biden won't secure our country, then Republicans need to step up and do it ourselves.**_**** Sitting around and waiting for something to happen simply isn't an option anymore.

I'm fired up by what's happening in Texas. I plan to bring more Texas-style leadership to Washington!

# WEEKLY NEWSLETTER
EARLY VOTING STARTS: FEBRUARY 3rd (in just 9 days)
JANUARY 25, 2024
**A message from former North Hempstead Town Supervisor Jon Kaiman**
In just a few weeks, we are poised to win back what George Santos took from us so many months ago...a congressional district represented by a rational, experienced, effective leader who will focus on dialogue, hard work, and results.

I've worked with Tom Suozzi in the political trenches for more than 30 years. He and so many others, myself included, have been taking on the Republican political machine in Nassau County year after year so that we as a community can get the full value of our hard-earned tax dollars, solutions to the complex problems we face, honest and effective government, and leaders in whom we can believe.

The unusual times that we are in have us fighting for American Democracy while also fighting to sustain basic truths and core values. In this vein, we are up against sophisticated misinformation campaigns, challenging worldwide crises, and longstanding voter apathy. And we are fighting against a Republican political machine that is well-funded and fully vested.

The good news is: We have the better candidate, an honest message, a talented organization, a fully funded campaign, a larger base of voters, and...we have you.

With three weeks left until Election Day, the time is now for each of us to go all-in on helping in every way that we can. Let each of us give everything we have to give until we cross the finish line on February 13, successful and victorious.

Sincerely,
Jon Kaiman

# CONGRESSMAN SUOZZI IN THE DISTRICT
On last Monday, the Westbury Committee and Congressman Suozzi gathered at the Yes We Can Community Center to honor Martin Luther King, Jr.
On last Tuesday, IAMPAC arranged a wonderful opportunity for Congressman Suozzi to meet with his fellow Italian Americans at Tony’s Beechhurst Deli.
On last Wednesday, Congressman Suozzi joined the Council of Korean Churches of Greater NY at their new year celebration today. The theme for the event was “We are the community!”
On Thursday Morning, Congressman Suozzi participated in the Plainview-Old Bethpage, Syosset-Woodbury, and Hicksville Chambers of Commerce Candidates Forum. Planned as a forum with TWO candidates discussing issues of importance to voters, he was the only candidate to participate. His opponent was nowhere to be found.
Later on Thursday, Congressman Suozzi attended another forum, at the Northwest Bayside Civic Association’s Candidate Forum. Both candidates were invited, and once again, he was the only candidate who showed up.
Last but not least, Congressman Suozzi attended a third forum on Thursday, hosted by We Love Whitestone. Once again, voters were presented with opportunities to hear from the candidates and ask questions. And, once again, both candidates were invited and Congressman Suozzi was the only candidate who showed up...again.
On Friday evening, Congressman Suozzi had a wonderful gathering with his friends from the South Asian community. Thank you to everyone who showed out in support!
On Saturday Morning, Congressman Suozzi’s Union friends gathered to demonstrate their support for his campaign. A big thank you to The Long Island Federation Of Labor for organizing the labor walk.

body:

[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=3ae9730250544ba2a718734360625547&_e=cXWopi2RN78aS4T1d982Rhkj_gNFICNmPxKvoREDscHeo6bI8SmQh4s6hRak0WL17ti0_DUQdhjymAOQDdazjHZ3CORTn_oZ4b056d8weLxZyJPTGs6OTd5mBDQzmWrF0nvwqpj9s83TWdt6SnOx4m7Gg_1E1xnnfPSvVDAIX4bcXdFwlbL2M-CF8PBXArH5YQ82UUoRm-NA9ejTRA87RQWBX892smhFfL2DncP98MVYEbXh_LGdrkbnUHN80Wwx5V3WYoH6BXMm8AJrux4mwAn-7z5XSrbzwsuPgDpwnsjXBKEd46euOta4w2KhwtzYGYiDNS9-it5WjAdO3819diW15EmhpwmRESmK-TDThpo%3D)
Peter,

When I stepped off stage in New Hampshire, here is the message I shared...

You've all heard the chatter among the political class. They're falling all over themselves saying this race is over.

Well, I have news for all of them. New Hampshire is first in the nation. **_It 's not last in the nation._**

**This race is far from over.** There are dozens of states left to go. And the next one is my sweet state of South Carolina!

At one point in this campaign, there were 14 of us running, and we were at two percent in the polls. Well, I'm a fighter. Now, we're the last one standing next to Donald Trump, and today we got close to half of the vote. We still have a ways to go, but we keep moving up.

For a lot of people, politics is way too personal. It's not personal for me.

I decided to run because I'm worried about the future of our country, and because it's time to put the negativity and chaos behind us.

We have an economy that is crushing middle-class Americans. We have a border that is totally open and dangerous, creating a disaster in our country. We have schools that are failing too many of our children. And we have a world on fire, with war in Europe and the Middle East, and a huge and growing threat from China.

And then you look at Washington. We have a Congress that fights about everything and accomplishes nothing. And we have Joe Biden in the White House, making one bad decision after another, when he's making any decisions at all.

Our country's in a real mess. _And the question is, who 's going to fix it?_

With Donald Trump, Republicans have lost almost every competitive election. We lost the Senate. We lost the House. We lost the White House. We lost in 2018, in 2020 and in 2022.

The worst kept secret in politics is how badly the Democrats want to run against Trump. They know Trump is the only Republican in the country who Biden can defeat.

You can't fix the mess if you don't win the election. A Trump nomination is a Biden win and a Kamala Harris presidency.

**I defeat Biden handily.**

With Donald Trump, you have one bout of chaos after another. This court case, that controversy, this tweet, that senior moment. You can't fix Joe Biden's chaos with Republican chaos.

The other day, Donald Trump accused me of not providing security at the Capitol on January 6th.

I've long called for mental competency tests for politicians over the age of 75. Trump claims he'd do better than me on one of those tests. Maybe he would, and maybe he wouldn't.

But if he thinks that, then he should have no problem standing on a debate stage with me!

Most Americans do not want a rematch between Biden and Trump. The first party to retire its 80-year-old candidate is going to win this election. I say it should be the Republicans!

**So our fight is not over, because we have a country to save.** | [JOIN OUR MOVEMENT](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=3ae9730250544ba2a718734360625547&_e=cXWopi2RN78aS4T1d982Rhkj_gNFICNmPxKvoREDscHeo6bI8SmQh4s6hRak0WL17ti0_DUQdhjymAOQDdazjHZ3CORTn_oZ4b056d8weLxZyJPTGs6OTd5mBDQzmWrF0nvwqpj9s83TWdt6SnOx4m7Gg_1E1xnnfPSvVDAIX4bcXdFwlbL2M-CF8PBXArH5YQ82UUoRm-NA9ejTRA87RSKK8WN7W7Qur-aS_t1cbez5kv6W-5STp_506hRYmgMq9VE2gzard7fXrg8IV59N2daoHs7oeDmwn3PHKEOW36zjhvrEdjQ9qWiEiz27o-VpPEphpjFsG2cKK-O84Eo3daTv7FdvlzXzSVapz675eC0%3D)
---

In the next two months, millions of voters in over 20 states will have their say. We should honor them and allow them to vote. And guess what, in the next two months, Joe Biden isn't going to get any younger or any better. We'll have all the time we need to beat Biden.

When we get to South Carolina, Donald Trump is going to have a harder time falsely attacking me. The great people of South Carolina know I cut their taxes. They know I signed the toughest immigration bill in the country. They know we passed voter ID, and tort reform, and ethics reform, and they know we moved 35,000 people from welfare to work.

clean_body: When I stepped off stage in New Hampshire, here is the message I shared... | | | | | Peter, When I stepped off stage in New Hampshire, here is the message I shared... You've all heard the chatter among the political class. They're falling all over themselves saying this race is over. Well, I have news for all of them. New Hampshire is first in the nation. It 's not last in the nation. This race is far from over. There are dozens of states left to go. And the next one is my sweet state of South Carolina! At one point in this campaign, there were 14 of us running, and we were at two percent in the polls. Well, I'm a fighter. Now, we're the last one standing next to Donald Trump, and today we got close to half of the vote. We still have a ways to go, but we keep moving up. For a lot of people, politics is way too personal. It's not personal for me. I decided to run because I'm worried about the future of our country, and because it's time to put the negativity and chaos behind us. We have an economy that is crushing middle-class Americans. We have a border that is totally open and dangerous, creating a disaster in our country. We have schools that are failing too many of our children. And we have a world on fire, with war in Europe and the Middle East, and a huge and growing threat from China. And then you look at Washington. We have a Congress that fights about everything and accomplishes nothing. And we have Joe Biden in the White House, making one bad decision after another, when he's making any decisions at all. Our country's in a real mess. And the question is, who 's going to fix it? With Donald Trump, Republicans have lost almost every competitive election. We lost the Senate. We lost the House. We lost the White House. We lost in 2018, in 2020 and in 2022. The worst kept secret in politics is how badly the Democrats want to run against Trump. They know Trump is the only Republican in the country who Biden can defeat. You can't fix the mess if you don't win the election. A Trump nomination is a Biden win and a Kamala Harris presidency. I defeat Biden handily. With Donald Trump, you have one bout of chaos after another. This court case, that controversy, this tweet, that senior moment. You can't fix Joe Biden's chaos with Republican chaos. The other day, Donald Trump accused me of not providing security at the Capitol on January 6th. I've long called for mental competency tests for politicians over the age of 75. Trump claims he'd do better than me on one of those tests. Maybe he would, and maybe he wouldn't. But if he thinks that, then he should have no problem standing on a debate stage with me! Most Americans do not want a rematch between Biden and Trump. The first party to retire its 80-year-old candidate is going to win this election. I say it should be the Republicans! So our fight is not over, because we have a country to save. | In the next two months, millions of voters in over 20 states will have their say. We should honor them and allow them to vote. And guess what, in the next two months, Joe Biden isn't going to get any younger or any better. We'll have all the time we need to beat Biden. When we get to South Carolina, Donald Trump is going to have a harder time falsely attacking me. The great people of South Carolina know I cut their taxes. They know I signed the toughest immigration bill in the country. They know we passed voter ID, and tort reform, and ethics reform, and they know we moved 35,000 people from welfare to work. Every time I've run for office in South Carolina, I've beaten the political establishment. They're lined up against me again. That's no surprise. But South Carolina voters don't want a coronation. They want an election. And we're going to give them one. Because we're just getting started. Let's do this! My very best, Nikki R. [**_Friend, this is my_** _**_real_**_** _story, without the media’s spin:_**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=caf6b27c35a54dcd8ee6abb56db3959f&_e=7a0tVL0s4DCwOIhd6_J2j_xC8gkwUL10YFOKfTMbLpAzBYqs2Tfcl3BRc8fWzeIe63Xe7H7GxGg2zv20QacE4kVLOope4YYNwxqLhrtP0nf736K-pBLYBrLx1jgRK3S1Kuby9UlJBDFTjaekTQStgn68KXqNqeG_KduJOZKy7rko5eGul6HiOcIyi7iD3UtDr-Aczz8CL8hrducDg-ZnSH8TLB-K20_4nwvjOHB0jvKfpksY0GBUOgVuqmk5K53QSaHVZe3g33wbskWdEjh-_aLZ8SSiah_c3OYttJZFKQbCxycJxM1XwBP4ys6UssUZvBZTw1sclfStq8nh48TP9_z4ihiG5RhXZ-wibC9Ip2_ggFiYXGQY1l_b-E9Zz5e6GnKpt5tXAbzhF1UojTmBYtuW7zOICXpA86ZqU8BhWtk%3D) From my earliest memories of childhood, my dad was my hero. Because he served as a firefighter and assistant chief training officer, my highest aspiration was to one day become the chief of the fire department of our hometown of Shreveport, Louisiana. But when I was just 12 years old, my dad was critically burned and permanently disabled in the line of duty. That fateful explosion changed the trajectory of all our lives. Following our family tragedy, I had to grow up fast, help my parents take care of my three younger siblings and small family farm, and consider other ways to serve. I became the first person in my family to go to college, and then to law school, and I dedicated my career in constitutional law to defending our fundamental freedoms in the courts. My wife Kelly and I got married in 1999, just as I was beginning my law practice. Like so many other couples, as our family grew, we became increasingly concerned about the condition of our country and what our children’s generation would inherit. About nine years ago, after much prayer and deliberation, we decided to heed the call to run for public office and do our best to make a difference. I was elected without opposition to the Louisiana Legislature, and a short time later, to an open seat in the U.S. Congress. Less than seven years after I arrived in Washington, on October 25, 2023, I was unanimously elected by my Republican colleagues to serve as the 56th Speaker of the House. When I was growing up, I never dreamed any of this would be possible. clean_body: Never forget where you came from| | | | That question has been asked and answered in the mainstream media constantly since I was elected Speaker of the House three months ago. It probably won’t surprise you that so much of what has been written and said isn’t accurate at all. A lot of it has been openly hostile. I wanted to take a moment to clarify a few things here because I expect you agree with me that these things are worth fighting for. From my earliest memories of childhood, my dad was my hero. Because he served as a firefighter and assistant chief training officer, my highest aspiration was to one day become the chief of the fire department of our hometown of Shreveport, Louisiana. But when I was just 12 years old, my dad was critically burned and permanently disabled in the line of duty. That fateful explosion changed the trajectory of all our lives. Following our family tragedy, I had to grow up fast, help my parents take care of my three younger siblings and small family farm, and consider other ways to serve. I became the first person in my family to go to college, and then to law school, and I dedicated my career in constitutional law to defending our fundamental freedoms in the courts. My wife Kelly and I got married in 1999, just as I was beginning my law practice. Like so many other couples, as our family grew, we became increasingly concerned about the condition of our country and what our children’s generation would inherit. About nine years ago, after much prayer and deliberation, we decided to heed the call to run for public office and do our best to make a difference. I was elected without opposition to the Louisiana Legislature, and a short time later, to an open seat in the U.S. Congress. Less than seven years after I arrived in Washington, on October 25, 2023, I was unanimously elected by my Republican colleagues to serve as the 56th Speaker of the House. When I was growing up, I never dreamed any of this would be possible. But I am humbled and truly grateful for this opportunity. Friend, you and I both know that America is facing today one of the greatest collections of crises in our nation’s history. The survival of our freedoms and the very future of our republic are hanging in the balance. SAVE America, we must keep and GROW the Republican Majority in the House. And to do that, I need partners and fellow warriors who are willing to fight by my side. And it has never been more important for us to stand together, defend truth and liberty, and restore the foundations of this extraordinary country God has given us. It will take all of us to succeed. And I need YOUR help. Sincerely, Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson you consider joining Team Johnson today?________________ | | | | Paid for by Mike Johnson for Louisiana |

subject: the greatest moral failing of our time
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
there have been more than 600 mass shootings in 2023
| | |
---
Friend, did you know that there have already been 25 mass shootings in 2024? **On average, more than 100 Americans die from gun violence _every single day._**
_This is the greatest moral failing of our time, friend._
I know the toll that this horrific violence takes on a family. When I was 24, my father was killed in an act of gun violence. Getting that news was the worst phone call of my life. But I was determined to channel my grief and pain into action.
Ever since then, I've fought to protect our communities from gun violence. In Congress, I pushed for commonsense reforms that would keep guns away from dangerous individuals.

After leaving Congress, I teamed up with Gabby Giffords to lead her gun safety advocacy work here in Florida and across the country. It was an honor to work so closely with Gabby, meeting so many survivors of gun violence, hearing their stories, holding our lawmakers accountable, and fighting for change.
**Now, I'm running for Senate to defeat Rick Scott, one of the gun lobby's biggest allies, and finally pass the common-sense reforms that families are counting on. Experts say this race will be one of the most competitive elections this November, but I need your help to take on Scott's massive fortune.

Peter, I’m about to explain why your donation will go the furthest in Pennsylvania, [**but first, can you make a donation to Bob Casey’s re-election campaign?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240125-1?recurring=1&refcode=em20240125-1&refcode2=1791_552475_BLXhcN&akid=1791%2E552475%2EBLXhcN)
— Pennsylvania has some of the**most expensive media markets** in the country. We need a ton of grassroots support to get our ads on the air and share Bob’s message with voters across the Commonwealth.
— Bob is **up against a mega-millionaire opponent who has**** _already_****dumped $1 million into his campaign** and has plenty more where that came from.
— A recent poll shows this Senate race is **closer than ever before.**

Rural frustrations mount when we are excluded from connectivity, e.g. broadband and air travel
Are residents in Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula getting the necessary transportation help they deserve? Air travel has dwindled, but travel is vital to our communities, for business and pleasure.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Air%20Travel_2.png]
Rural America is dependent on our connectivity to thrive. Your contributions are helping our campaign champion rural broadband and infrastructure improvements. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

Friend,
In Michigan's First District, rail transport service is nonexistent. Public transportation is limited, especially for our seniors traveling for medical care. Rural broadband isn't functional in many places, especially the 'last mile'.
Our infrastructure needs improving. While trekking across Northern Michigan and the UP, many travelers can't get phone service from their cars for miles. How do you call for help when you can't call?
Despite having an excellent airport, Marquette residents travel to Green Bay to fly, and others do the same, including myself and my family.
When services are available, sometimes they really aren't.
A recent example comes from a citizen trying to get TSA pre-approval in Northern Michigan. They traveled several hours to an overfilled and crowded waiting room, only to find a sole worker, someone without broadband connectivity or functional equipment to complete the interview and grant their approval.
After hours of waiting, the traveler left, along with many others, dissatisfied and grumpy without their mission accomplished – no TSA pre-approval. The problem? Lack of connectivity, which was known for weeks.
We need to invest to help rural America so it's not forgotten or flown over.
What's the solution? Investment in infrastructure, and the Rural Electrification Act of 1936. The REA was passed with bipartisan support and gives us our roadmap to accomplish it.
Rural America needs help becoming part of the 21st century. My opponent, Rep. Jack Bergman, blames Democrats, but that's far from the truth. Despite taking credit for legislation, Bergman has repeatedly voted against rural broadband in the district.
We need a representative willing to solve problems and invest in our district, someone who lives here and understands how to advocate for all of us.
That's why I'm running.
- Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser

subject: My friend Jamaal’s big announcement
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
When right-wing megadonors attack one of us, they’re trying to silence our whole movement.
And in this moment, standing strongly beside leaders calling for peace and humanity has never been more important.
**My friend Jamaal Bowman just officially announced his campaign for re-election.** [Help us show that we have the people power to beat his AIPAC-backed opponent by splitting a grassroots donation between our campaigns.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240125-bowman.wdtTTk&refcode=em20240125-5701-P_FND_ANO_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5701%2E2526796%2EshT3A9)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240125-bowman.wdtTTk&refcode=em20240125-5701-P_FND_ANO_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5701%2E2526796%2EshT3A9)**
Jamaal’s opponent is an establishment, career politician — **who yesterday was officially endorsed by AIPAC**.1 The path to victory won’t be easy. AIPAC will launch millions of dollars of nasty attack ads.
But our diverse coalition is ready to step up.
**This is about justice. This is about community. This is about what we want the Democratic Party — and our democracy — to look like.**
[Jamaal and I believe it should reflect working people, not right-wing millionaires. If you’re with us, help Jamaal launch a strong re-election campaign by splitting a donation today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240125-bowman.wdtTTk&refcode=em20240125-5701-P_FND_ANO_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5701%2E2526796%2EshT3A9)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240125-bowman.wdtTTk&refcode=em20240125-5701-P_FND_ANO_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=5701%2E2526796%2EshT3A9)**
Whether or not you’re able to contribute today, we’re so grateful that you are a part of this movement. Thank you for standing with us, and thank you for standing for a better world for all.
Onward,

ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
Hi—I’m Olivia Julianna. I’m a fourth-generation Texan, a fierce abortion rights activist, and a proud member of #TeamLizzie.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240125?refcode=lpfe240125 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240125?refcode=lpfe240125]
I’ve supported Lizzie during her primary and general elections in past elections, and I’m excited to be on board again for 2024. And guess what—Lizzie is facing a primary challenge this year, and the election is a little over five weeks away!
I’m working with #TeamLizzie in the coming weeks to talk to voters about the primary here in TX-07 and to help get voters to the polls to cast their ballots for Lizzie.
Why? Because we need strong, pro-choice leaders like Lizzie in Texas—especially in the wake of the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade and our state putting one of the most extreme abortion bans on the books. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240125?refcode=lpfe240125]
In Congress, Lizzie is working to restore Roe and she’s leading the charge to protect women’s right to travel out of state for abortion care. That’s especially crucial right now as several Texas counties have passed ordinances that prohibit people from using local roads to drive someone out of state for an abortion.
So yeah—it’s really important that we re-elect Lizzie this year. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240125?refcode=lpfe240125]
Texas has a long history of strong women leaders: Ann Richards. Barbara Jordan. Linda Coffee. Sarah Weddington.
Lizzie is part of that rich history. She’s one of the most pro-choice lawmakers in the House today. (When she was a teenager, she was a Planned Parenthood activist!)
I’m committed to giving Lizzie my support this election, and I hope you’ll join me. Campaigns like Lizzie’s have important fundraising benchmarks at the end of each month, and the next one is less than a week away. Any amount you can contribute will help us do the critical work we need to do in 2024. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240125?refcode=lpfe240125]
Thanks!
Olivia

subject: Prolonged war is not the solution

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

We are witnessing a humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza. Over 24,000 civilians have been killed since the war began [https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2024/01/14/israel-gaza-low-intensity/] , the majority of them women and children. 70% of the homes destroyed. A virtual embargo on humanitarian aid. We need a permanent ceasefire, full hostage release, and large-scale humanitarian aid to be allowed in.

The United States must focus on how to stop the bombing, how to release the hostages, and how to save lives now.

Prolonged war is not the solution. We need a permanent cease-fire, release of all hostages, and start negotiations for an independent Palestinian state with equal rights living side by side with a secure Israel.

Sign if you agree: we must support an immediate, lasting ceasefire and the release of all hostages now. [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/permanent-ceasefire?source=group-ro-khanna&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fdfa-gaza-ceasefire-petition-swap]

https://actionnetwork.org/forms/permanent-ceasefire?source=group-ro-khanna&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fdfa-gaza-ceasefire-petition-swap [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/permanent-ceasefire?source=group-ro-khanna&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fdfa-gaza-ceasefire-petition-swap]

Israel had the right to defend itself following the October 7th Hamas attack, but the U.S. should never have given Netanyahu's far-right government such a green light to bomb civilians in the manner we've witnessed over the past many weeks.

Tell the Biden Administration: Support an immediate, permanent ceasefire in Gaza. [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/permanent-ceasefire?source=group-ro-khanna&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fdfa-gaza-ceasefire-petition-swap]

Sign the Petition [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/permanent-ceasefire?source=group-ro-khanna&referrer=group-ro-khanna&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fdfa-gaza-ceasefire-petition-swap]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

| This fight hits close to home.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=1906%2E35263%2E36gzby)
[](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-jan24.HgOSTk&refcode=AU_STB_CL_GEN_NOA_AC_20240125_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=1906%2E35263%2E36gzby) Peter — When I was young, I remember what it was like to come home from school and not be able to get into the house. I’d pound on the door, but my mother wouldn’t answer. She’d be passed out inside. My mother struggled with mental illness and addiction to prescription drugs her entire life. I began speaking candidly about her story after hearing from so many others who have been impacted by addiction. When I hear Wisconsin families share how the opioid epidemic has wrecked their lives, I hear so many experiences I can relate to, because I’ve been there. I know how hard this fight is. I know the stigma that comes with addiction and mental illness. This fight is deeply personal for me, as it is for Wisconsin families in every corner of our state. **So I’m committed to doing everything I can to end it.** In the Senate, I worked to pass bipartisan legislation and led efforts to secure a $1 billion emergency investment to fight the epidemic. I helped deliver life-saving resources to support local treatment, recovery, and prevention efforts. And I’m not done working to deliver even more for our communities. We’re stronger when we work together and listen to one another. As any person who has felt the impact of the opioid crisis knows, this fight won’t be easy — but I believe we can make change when we work together and have somewhere to turn for help. Thank you for reading this message today. I’m sharing my mother’s story with you because I know mental illness and addiction are nothing to be ashamed of. I think my mother would want to know that her story is helping others. — Tammy | | **Tammy is on the ballot in 2024. * We've assembled an Advisory Board that reflects the region's rich demographics to ensure that our campaign continues to resonate with the diverse voices of Central Washington.

* We're coordinating a scientific poll to gauge the real impact of our programs, providing valuable insights into the effectiveness of our messaging and outreach efforts.

But to sustain this crucial work, we rely on your support. Your recurring monthly donations provide the financial stability we need to plan for the future of the program.

The [Dayton Chronicle](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/feOpvDzhR/c?w=Bnvi40R1tmcvIAQcmeB1C4i87UuO4Xw6tssR1XW-bWk.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZGF5dG9uY2hyb25pY2xlLmNvbS9zdG9yeS8yMDIyLzA1LzE5L25ld3MvbmV3bHktZm9ybWVkLXBhYy1zdXBwb3J0cy1wcm9ncmVzcy8yOTYwLmh0bWwiLCJyIjoiNTU1YjNjMDQtZDVmYS00NWJiLWI2ZDMtODI4OGYxZTFjZWE2IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) reveals the formation of the Columbia County-based non-profit [Neighbors United for Progress](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/feOpvDzhR/c?w=5GX2XiCDwTaQpOZyx-1NToTcQQc7AixbOZhhBWGcPcc.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmFjZWJvb2suY29tL25laWdoYm9yc3VuaXRlZGZvcnByb2dyZXNzIiwiciI6IjU1NWIzYzA0LWQ1ZmEtNDViYi1iNmQzLTgyODhmMWUxY2VhNiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) (NUP) in 2022. These changes aim to fortify defenses against extremist groups and prevent the metaphorical "burning down" of community institutions.For more details on the legislative developments, refer to Senate Bill 5824 ([5824.pdf](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/feOpvDzhR/c?w=U3GeerKBOM8Qwy1wdNOHuJ37zeUtmwL0OvDYDl91r3g.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9sYXdmaWxlc2V4dC5sZWcud2EuZ292L2JpZW5uaXVtLzIwMjMtMjQvUGRmL0JpbGxzL1NlbmF0ZSUyMEJpbGxzLzU4MjQucGRmI3BhZ2U9MSZ0b29sYmFyPTAmbmF2cGFuZXM9MCIsInIiOiJkOTIyYzgwYi1lMTE4LTQyYjYtYmIyZS05NTg1MGM0YjI3NDciLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ)) and catch NUP Chair Elise Severe's testimony on [Senate State Government & Elections - TVW](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/feOpvDzhR/c?w=1JmWRPcPU2hLBP-tgfVCfxvTFDVasbBvd5IPrwXC9So.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly90dncub3JnL3ZpZGVvL3NlbmF0ZS1zdGF0ZS1nb3Zlcm5tZW50LWVsZWN0aW9ucy0yMDI0MDExMTE2Lz9ldmVudElEPTIwMjQwMTExMTYiLCJyIjoiZDkyMmM4MGItZTExOC00MmI2LWJiMmUtOTU4NTBjNGIyNzQ3IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0). | | MAGA's School Board Failures: Pushing Religious Schools
---
| | An unrelenting assault on our public education system by far-right extremists is nothing short of an attack on the very fabric of our nation. From denying access to knowledge and perpetuating segregation to replacing science with religious doctrine and even advocating for the closure of the Department of Education, these tactics are central to the Republican Party's agenda.
---
| | Partnering with Parents:Educating Christian Patriots

Peter,

**As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle.** Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

subject: The second step for our generation
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Let me tell you what I think, friend.
Young people are smart. We pay attention to the issues. We're showing up to vote.
But to me, this is only the first step for our generation. The second step?
We need young people on the ballot. We need young people in elected office.
That’s why I teamed up with Kevin Lata, the campaign manager who helped elect the first ever Gen-Z member of Congress last year, to launch Leaders We Deserve.
Friend, if you agree that we need more young, courageous leaders running for office, will you split a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Serve America? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
As a generation, we grew up hearing that to survive a school shooting, we had to run, hide, and fight. I think our generation needs to reinterpret what that means.
*
We
need
to
run—for
office
.
Representation
won’t
happen
on
its
own.
*
We
need
to
stop
hiding
from
our
responsibility
to
our
country
and
planet.
*
We

to

for
a

government
and
a
better
future
for
everyone.
That’s why Leaders We Deserve exists. We’re helping young people run for office and win—like Nadarius Clark, our endorsed candidate who just won in Virginia.
Leaders We Deserve was founded to recruit and support the next generation of leaders. Will you help us take the second step and split a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Serve America? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
Thanks for everything you do for this movement,
David Hogg

body:
Sign here to join us in demanding Congress seize at least 70% of corporate windfall profits & redistribute these funds to the poor and working class

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240125organized_greed&n=1)
